items.title: 从照片生成动漫风编辑海报
items.prompt:
将参考照片转化为一张高端、风格化的动漫风时尚海报，同时精准保留人物的面部特征、发型、姿势、太阳镜、珍珠耳环以及红色羽绒服。

打造惊艳的双联垂直构图：

上幅画面：以湛蓝天空为背景的女性超写实肖像，沐浴在温暖的黄金时刻阳光下，微风自然吹拂发丝，佩戴亮橙色镜片太阳镜，皮肤纹理真实细腻，呈现电影级摄影质感。

下幅画面：将同一位女性重新演绎为细节丰富的“动漫+美漫”风格插画。完整保留她的面部特征、表情、发型、穿搭、配饰及姿势。运用极具张力的橙色轮廓光、富有表现力的精细线条、浓郁的色彩以及高级图像小说级别的阴影处理。

海报设计：

* 深炭灰色背景搭配活力橙色点缀。
* 醒目的大号粗斜体文字“URBAN GLOW”。
* 较小的副标题：“CITY VIBES IN COLOR”。
* 动感的对角线橙色图形与几何元素。
* 现代街头潮流大片美学。
* 高对比度，高端杂志封面级设计。

重要提示：插画中的面部需与原照片高度一致。切勿改变人物身份、面部比例或标志性特征。超精细画质，4K 分辨率，专业海报设计，3:4 垂直构图。

items.title: 赛博朋克 2099 年肖像
items.prompt:
生成一张超写实电影级人像，描绘一位来自 2099 年的神秘青年男子，他伫立在雨夜中的未来赛博朋克城市里。

**人物外貌：** 一名年轻成年男性，深棕色头发蓬松凌乱，带有淡淡的浅色胡茬，皮肤纹理真实自然，下颌线轮廓分明，佩戴黑色圆框眼镜。他的双眼散发着强烈的电蓝色光芒，右侧太阳穴与脸颊处嵌有精细的蓝色机械电路纹路。神情平静、严肃、睿智且充满神秘感。保持自然的人类面部比例与逼真的面部细节。

**服装造型：** 身穿一件高级黑色未来感风衣，配有挺括的高立领，内搭黑色高领机能服。风衣面料呈现复杂的防水纹理与金属扣件，肩部和翻领处点缀着隐约发光的电蓝色灯带，表面布满细密的水珠。整体着装兼具实用性、昂贵质感与前沿科技感，但不会显得像全身机械改造人。

**环境背景：** 令人震撼的 2099 年未来超级都市，巨型玻璃摩天大楼林立，青蓝色的建筑线条闪烁发光，全息广告牌与悬浮数字广告交错，飞行器穿梭悬停于楼宇之间。画面右侧的人物身后，一个巨大的发光圆形时空传送门正散发着光芒。左侧的全息显示屏上浮现出数字“2099”以及“THE FUTURE IS NOW”字样。湿漉漉的街道倒映着蓝色霓虹灯光，远处撑着伞的行人在雨中穿行。

**光影与氛围：** 深邃的电影级蓝青色调，辅以微妙的紫色高光；湿润表面呈现逼真反射，搭配体积雾与大气透视效果；人物发丝与肩部边缘勾勒出极具戏剧性的轮廓光，眼镜片上泛着柔和的反光。雨水自然地洒落整个场景，面部、头发和外套上清晰可见颗颗分明的水珠。

**构图与镜头：** 9:16 竖版人像，胸部以上的中近景构图，人物居中，头部微微偏转，目光直视镜头、眼神锐利；浅景深，50mm 镜头，f/1.8 光圈，面部对焦锐利，未来感背景呈现柔和虚化，电影级透视视角。

**视觉品质：** 超写实人体结构，自然的面部不对称特征，根根分明的发丝细节，真实的皮肤毛孔，符合物理规律的雨水与反射效果，高动态范围（HDR），专业科幻电影摄影质感，高端电影海报美学，精致的场景美术设计，极致细腻的材质纹理，富有戏剧张力又真实可信的光影，8K 级细节表现。

**反向提示词：** cartoon, anime, illustration, plastic skin, artificial face, exaggerated muscles, oversized eyes, deformed glasses, asymmetrical pupils, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate people in foreground, blurry face, low resolut

items.title: 传奇武器获取场景
items.prompt:
请描绘附图中角色获得决定世界命运的传说级装备的那一刻。

保留角色的面部特征、发型、基础配色以及身份设定。

这件传说级装备的真面目，必须是从原本并非用于战斗的日常物品中全新构思出来的。不要指定具体的候选物品，也不要局限于适合该角色的物件。

请分别构思该物品的真实身份、它为何被视为传说、存放地点以及获取仪式，并将这些元素融合到同一个场景中。

让物品保持能一眼认出日常用途的形态。不要用华丽的装饰掩盖它的本来面目，也不要把它改成普通宝剑的形状。

获取瞬间的场景调度要庄重且充满仪式感。周围的人物和环境都要表现出深信此事至关重要的样子。

角色也要以极其严肃的态度对待这件物品，通过随意日常的物品与宏大仪式之间的反差来营造幽默感。

不要使用文字说明；将视觉焦点集中在角色的双手和传说级装备上。不要用光效遮挡面部或物品轮廓；创作一幅帅气与荒诞并存的动漫插画。

items.title: 身着荷叶边婚纱的动漫新娘
items.prompt: 一幅全身动漫风格插画，描绘了一位美丽的新娘站在纯白背景前。她留着深棕色头发，梳成优雅的发髻，几缕松散的刘海轻拂脸庞，头上点缀着精致的花朵头饰，耳畔垂着长长的耳坠。她的双眼大而灵动，妆容淡雅，神情柔和又自信。婚纱细节极为丰富：抹胸心形领口上衣带有繁复的系带束腰设计，边缘装饰着立体花卉贴花。丰盈的落肩袖自然垂下，化作极具张力的层叠荷叶边，顺着裙身两侧倾泻而下。高开叉设计展露出她线条优美的一条腿，裙摆上蔓延着拖尾般的花卉装饰。长长的裙裾在底部铺展开来，由多层轻盈飘逸的面料堆叠而成。她脚踩尖头高跟鞋，脚踝处系着小巧的蝴蝶结。一层薄透的头纱从脑后垂落，轻轻披覆在双肩与背部。画风线条利落、赛璐璐上色平滑流畅，配色精致典雅，以白色、米色和温暖的肤色为主调。

items.title: 六款杂志封面
items.prompt:
生成一张高分辨率横版图片，在纯白背景上并排展示六本风格各异的杂志封面。所有封面的主角均为同一位动漫风格的年轻女性——齐肩棕发、蓝色眼眸，但每本封面都根据杂志类型为她搭配了不同的服装与造型。

从左至右，各封面内容如下：
1. 女性时尚：标题为“凛と日和”。她身穿珊瑚色上衣搭配白色长裤，手提一款包包。
2. 动漫/游戏：标题为“アニマギア”。她身着未来感十足的霓虹紫色偶像打歌服，点缀着发光细节。
3. 商业：标题为“週刊ビジネス羅針盤”。她穿着干练的深灰色职业套装，手持一台平板电脑。
4. 旅行：标题为“旅色めぐり”。她身穿休闲橙色外套，以群山风景为背景站立。
5. 烹饪：标题为“おいしい毎日”。她在黄色衬衫外系着围裙，站在摆满新鲜食材的厨房中。
6. 神秘学：标题为“異界探訪”。她身穿暗红色维多利亚风格长裙，置身于神秘幽暗的场景之中。

每本封面都必须包含地道的日文排版、醒目标题以及真实杂志常见的小字文本块。
tags: 角色设定图展示了一位动漫少女作为六种不同类型日本杂志的封面模

items.title: 动漫三格漫画感想
items.prompt:
目标：创作一幅垂直布局的三格动漫风格漫画条，标题为《体验 Opus 5.5 后的感想》。

画布：采用垂直布局，三个独立的画面上下堆叠排列。

第 1 格（顶部）：
- 主体：一名留着凌乱黑发、眼中闪烁着星星的年轻男子，正兴奋地注视着一位长发橙色头发、穿着向日葵主题连衣裙的开朗女孩。
- 对话气泡（男子）：“体验过 Opus 5.5 之后……哇……太迷人了……！！”
- 信息框（右侧）：一个黄色的装饰性方框，标签为“Claude:”，内含文字“年轻又聪明，让生活充满色彩！”。
- 背景：明亮阳光下的向日葵花田。

第 2 格（中间）：
- 主体：同一名男子现在双手捂脸，紧张地出汗。他身旁站着一位优雅的白色长发女性，长着角，表情冷漠。
- 对话气泡（男子）：“糟了，这感觉像是在出轨……失去了新婚时的激情……”
- 信息框（左侧）：一个紫色的装饰性方框，标签为“Wife GPT:”，内含文字“依然美丽优雅，但有点冷淡。”。
- 背景：较暗的室内场景，配有蓝色窗帘。

第 3 格（底部）：
- 主体：火车站台场景。男子躲在柱子后偷看，脸颊泛红，旁边是那位橙发女孩（Claude）。在背景中，白发女子（Wife GPT）站在远处的一列火车旁注视着他们。
- 指示牌：上方悬挂的蓝色标牌写着“换乘站 ->”。
- 对话气泡（左侧）：“家里规矩严，只能在换乘站偷偷见面！小声点……”
- 对话气泡（右侧）：“我都知道……静静地看着。”

视觉风格：干净的数字插画，第一格色彩鲜艳，第二格色调柔和，第三格采用写实光影效果。
tags: 一幅幽默的三格漫画风格作品，描绘了用户在新款“Opus 5.

items.title: 春丽踢飞巨型怪物
items.prompt: 这是一幅高分辨率的数字插画，采用充满活力的漫画风格，描绘了一场混乱的街头格斗场景。画面右侧是《街头霸王》中的春丽，她身穿标志性的蓝色旗袍（饰有金色滚边）和白色长靴，正执行一记强力高踢，直接命中一只体型庞大的绿色皮肤怪物的躯干。该怪物外形类似布兰卡，但体型更大、肌肉更发达，拥有狂野的红发、锋利的爪子和发光的双眼，在承受冲击时痛苦咆哮。前景中，《街头霸王》中的隆身着破损的白色道服，倒在布满瓦砾的地面上，显得伤痕累累且已失去意识。背景是一条粗犷的城市小巷，砖砌建筑、消防梯和溢出的垃圾桶在戏剧性的橙紫色天空下若隐若现。撞击点向外爆发出碎片与尘土。
tags: 一幅充满动感的插画，展示春丽对一只巨大的绿色怪物施展毁灭性踢

items.title: 暗黑哥特魔女海报
items.prompt: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: {argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: {argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: {argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。"}. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.

items.title: Japanese Elephant Day Magazine Feature
items.titleZh: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm bota…
items.prompt: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm botanical watercolor style, formatted as a full-page A4 portrait layout with a cream paper background, thin beige border, muted sage-green accents, and a refined nature-themed design. The page is a single cohesive magazine spread design with 6 distinct content sections: 1 large main illustration panel on the left, 1 tall title-and-article column on the upper right, 3 stacked informational point boxes on the mid-to-lower right, 2 small photo-card style image panels along the lower left, 1 circular quote badge near the lower left of the main panel, and 1 summary box at the lower right. The theme is elephant appreciation day in Japan. At the top left, place small editorial header text reading "LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC" with a short Japanese subtitle beneath it. Across the upper right, add the large date heading "4.28 EVENT" and the main Japanese headline "象の日特集" in an elegant serif style, with a short subheading line beneath it and a tiny elephant icon. Below that, set 3 short Japanese body paragraphs in a clean magazine column, explaining elephant day. The main illustration panel shows a gentle elephant standing on the left, rendered in delicate watercolor with realistic wrinkles, large ears, soft ivory-gray skin, and a lowered trunk reaching toward a small child standing beside it. The child is an androgynous anime-style boy with messy wavy dark purple-black hair, pale skin, large eyes, a black graphic T-shirt with a purple emblem, loose brown knee-length cargo shorts, and bare feet, standing casually with one hand in a pocket while touching the elephant’s trunk with the other. Behind them is a sunny zoo walkway with a wooden fence, soft green trees, dappled light, and leafy branches hanging from above. Near the elephant, include a small wooden sign reading "Elephant 4.28". Add a circular text badge in Japanese near the lower left of the main image. On the lower left area, place exactly 2 small bordered snapshot-style panels with taped-corner scrapbook presentation: the first labeled "Feeding Time" showing the child in side profile offering leaves to the elephant’s trunk across a fence; the second labeled "Peaceful Time" showing the child seated on a wooden bench in profile with elephants in the background, in a calm reflective scene. Each small panel has a short Japanese caption underneath. On the right side, stack exactly 3 informational boxes labeled "POINT 01", "POINT 02", and "POINT 03" in olive green circles, each with a simple line icon and Japanese text: box 1 features an elephant icon and discusses memory, box 2 features a trunk or elephant-face icon and discusses delicacy despite size, box 3 features a zoo building icon and discusses what can be learned at the zoo. At the bottom right, add 1 bordered summary box with a ribbon-like header reading "まとめ", a small elephant silhouette, and 2 short Japanese summary paragraphs. Along the bottom margin, include the page number "068", the date "APRIL 2025", and a row of small walking elephant silhouettes. Add subtle botanical flourishes, leaves, and light decorative strokes throughout. Overall mood: gentle, educational, heartwarming, airy, natural, child-friendly, and sophisticated, like a premium seasonal magazine feature.

items.titleZh: 华丽舞台偶像演出插画
items.promptZh: 全身奇幻动漫风格插图，描绘了一位迷人的年轻偶像般的女性在宏伟的巴洛克宫殿大厅内华丽的镀金舞台上表演。她以戏剧性的低角度姿势站在雕花的金色阳台或平台上，一条腿向前，稍微交叉，左臂以强烈的透视方式伸向观众，另一只手轻轻地放在胸前。她身材苗条、优雅，长长的深棕色头发在空中飘逸，戴着装饰性花卉和丝带头饰。她的表情应该充满自信、戏剧性和迷人。她穿着一件精致的褶边表演连衣裙，颜色为{argument name="dress Colors" default="宝蓝色、深红色、白色和金色"}：合身的紧身胸衣，带有金色镶边和红色前幅、白色蕾丝胸围和袖子、分层荷叶边短裙、宽大的漩涡罩裙和斗篷式织物镶片，镶有金色刺绣，在她周围戏剧性地翻滚。添加华丽的脚踝配饰，搭配相配的丝带花朵、白色高跟鞋或短靴，以及奢华细致的面料纹理。背景是一个装饰华丽的内部空间，左边有一扇发光的哥特式拱形窗户，顶部和左侧有一张厚重的深红色天鹅绒窗帘，右墙上有一幅华丽画框的大型古典油画，她身后有一根高高的雕刻柱，左下角有一朵丰富的玫瑰和浅色花朵，前景有一根镀金栏杆。温暖的金色背光透过彩色玻璃般的窗户，营造出明亮的光环、柔和的薄雾、头发和服装上的边缘光以及深邃的电影阴影。几片玫瑰花瓣飘散在空中。高度细致、超精致、浪漫、雄伟、动感的构图、丰富的纹理、绘画般的动漫插画、逼真的灯光和奢华的幻想偶像美学。
items.prompt: A full-body fantasy anime-style illustration of a glamorous young idol-like woman performing on an ornate gilded stage inside a grand baroque palace hall. She stands in a dramatic low-angle pose on a carved gold balcony or platform, one leg forward and slightly crossed, with her left arm thrust toward the viewer in strong foreshortening and her other hand resting lightly at her chest. She has a slim, elegant build, very long flowing dark brown hair streaming in the air, and a decorative floral and ribbon headpiece. Her expression should feel confident, theatrical, and captivating. She wears an elaborate frilled performance dress in {argument name="dress colors" default="royal blue, crimson red, white, and gold"}: a fitted corset bodice with gold trim and red front panel, white lace bust and sleeves, layered short ruffled skirt, and large swirling overskirts and cape-like fabric panels edged with gold embroidery that billow dramatically around her. Add ornate ankle accessories with matching ribbon flowers, white heeled shoes or short boots, and luxurious detailed fabric textures. The setting is a richly decorated interior with 1 large glowing gothic arched window on the left, 1 heavy dark red velvet curtain framing the top and left side, 1 large classical oil painting in an ornate frame on the right wall, 1 tall carved column behind her, 1 abundant arrangement of roses and pale flowers at the lower left, and 1 gilded balustrade across the foreground. Warm golden backlight streams through the stained-glass-like window, creating a luminous halo, soft haze, rim light on her hair and costume, and deep cinematic shadows. A few rose petals drift in the air. Highly detailed, ultra-polished, romantic, majestic, dynamic composition, rich textures, painterly anime illustration with realistic lighting and luxurious fantasy idol aesthetics.

items.title: 龙女王悬崖奇幻插画
items.promptZh: 一幅雄伟的奇幻插图，描绘了一位站在悬崖边缘的富丽堂皇的龙女王，以全身和面向左侧的侧面轮廓显示。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}长发，层次分明，长发垂过腰际，表情平静严肃，头戴精致的皇冠头饰，头饰上有数根向后掠过的角状金色长刺。她的服装是皇家礼服和铠甲紧身衣的华丽融合，采用{argument name="primary Palette" default="黑色、象牙色和古董金色"}，上面覆盖着复杂的花丝、藤蔓状镀金窗饰和优雅的裂纹大理石风格图案。该服装有 4 个主要的可见服装元素：合身的黑色和象牙色装甲躯干、带有飘逸镶片的分层长裙、带有金色镶边的深色斗篷，以及大腿高的合身腿甲或靴子。她手持一把长礼仪剑，垂直插在身侧，纤细且极具装饰性。在她的身后和周围升起一条巨大的黑龙的轮廓，它有长长的咆哮头和巨大的弧形翅膀，它的身体像守护者的影子一样包围着她；翅膀上饰有微妙的金色纹理图案。背景呈现出苍白、极简主义的奇幻景观，下方是远处的哥特式城堡尖顶建筑群、开阔的平原、淡淡的水或沼泽地，以及柔和的奶油色天空下的远山。构图是垂直的、优雅的、电影般的，人物居中稍偏右，龙头位于左上方，长长的丝带和织物在风中飘扬。风格是精致的动漫奇幻概念艺术，超细致的线条、内敛的色彩、发光的象牙负空间、奢华的黑金装饰、空灵的氛围、锐利的轮廓设计和高贵的神圣龙的情绪。
items.prompt: A majestic high-fantasy illustration of a regal dragon queen standing on the edge of a cliff, shown in full body and side profile facing left. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair flowing in long layered strands far past her waist, a calm stern expression, and an elaborate crown-like headdress with multiple long horn-shaped golden spines sweeping backward. Her outfit is an ornate fusion of royal gown and armored bodysuit in {argument name="primary palette" default="black, ivory, and antique gold"}, covered with intricate filigree, vine-like gilded tracery, and elegant cracked-marble style patterns. The costume has 4 major visible garment elements: a fitted black-and-ivory armored torso, a long layered split skirt with flowing panels, a dark sweeping cape with gold trim, and thigh-high fitted leg armor or boots. She holds 1 long ceremonial sword planted vertically at her side, slim and highly decorative. Behind and around her rises the silhouette of 1 enormous black dragon with a long snarling head and vast arcing wings, its body framing her like a guardian shadow; the wings are detailed with subtle gold vein patterns. The background shows a pale, minimalist fantasy landscape with 1 distant gothic castle spire complex below, open plains, faint water or marshland, and far mountains under a soft cream sky. Composition is vertical, elegant, and cinematic, with the character centered slightly right, the dragon head to the upper left, and long ribbons and fabric streaming in the wind. Style is refined anime-inspired fantasy concept art with ultra-detailed linework, restrained colors, luminous ivory negative space, luxurious black-and-gold ornamentation, ethereal atmosphere, sharp silhouette design, and a noble sacred-draconic mood.

items.titleZh: 长发公主高塔动漫插画
items.promptZh: 一个异想天开的动漫童话插图，{argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} 从高高的石塔窗户探出身子，从外面以稍微升高的角度观看。她穿着一件柔和的薰衣草紫色中世纪风格公主裙，泡泡袖、白色蕾丝饰边和合身紧身胸衣，还戴着粉色和白色的兔耳发带。她极长的{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown"}头发被设计成一根巨大的粗辫子，从窗台上垂下来，直垂到图像的整个高度。一只毛茸茸的小白兔坐在她的右肩上，增添了可爱的幻想气息。这座塔是浅米色的石头建造的，有一个像阳台一样的圆形窗台、一个拱形的开口、深紫色的内部窗帘，墙壁和窗框周围爬满了绿色的常春藤。背景呈现出阳光明媚的故事书般的风景，蔚蓝的天空、散落的白云、连绵起伏的青山、蜿蜒的河流、一座三拱门的石桥，以及远处有城堡或大教堂的欧式小镇。气氛是胜利的、迷人的、神奇的，就像精心打磨的高端奇幻动漫的关键视觉效果。细致的绘画渲染，柔和的自然光，干净的线条，柔和大气的透视，茂密的树叶，优雅的构图，垂直的格式。
items.prompt: A whimsical anime fairytale illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} leaning out from a high stone tower window, viewed from outside at a slightly elevated angle. She wears a soft lavender medieval-inspired princess dress with puff sleeves, white lace trim, and a fitted bodice, plus a pink-and-white bunny ear headband. Her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is styled into a single enormous thick braid that spills over the windowsill and drops straight down the full height of the image. A small fluffy white rabbit sits on her right shoulder, adding a cute fantasy touch. The tower is pale beige stone with a rounded balcony-like window ledge, an arched opening, deep purple interior curtains, and green ivy climbing around the walls and window frame. In the background, show a bright sunlit storybook landscape with a vivid blue sky, scattered white clouds, rolling green hills, a winding river, a stone bridge with 3 arches, and a distant European-style town with a castle or cathedral. The mood is triumphant, charming, and magical, like a polished high-end fantasy anime key visual. Detailed painterly rendering, soft natural daylight, clean linework, gentle atmospheric perspective, lush foliage, elegant composition, vertical format.

items.title: 霓虹赛博猫娘汽水
items.promptZh: 超动态的动画插图，霓虹灯网络偶像猫女孩以极端的透视视角将汽水瓶推向观众，瓶子占据前景，角色填充背景。她有 {argument name="hair color" default="long lavender-to-cyangradient hair"}、2 个黑色猫耳、柔软的粉红色内毛，以及 1 个发光的光环漂浮在她的头顶上。她的脸大部分被图像右中的实心方形审查块隐藏，而她狂野飘逸的头发则向外爆炸成丝带和股线。她穿着一套光亮的黑白未来派街头服饰，深领口，短款夹克，金属肩带，小配饰，胸前佩戴圆形粉色徽章。她的可见手握着 1 个标有 {argument name="brand name" default="Nyan SODA"} 的塑料汽水瓶，长指甲涂有两种颜色：青色和粉红色。瓶子是透明的，里面装满了闪闪发光的深紫色苏打水、发光的气泡和霓虹灯亮点，它向上喷发出生动的洋红色液体。用 1 场结晶冰块、无数水滴、油漆般的飞溅、闪闪发光的颗粒和能量弧包围场景。使用由电洋红、紫罗兰色、靛蓝和青色组成的强烈调色板，具有高对比度、光泽反射、光晕照明和发光边缘光。背景应该是液体、光线和运动的抽象爆炸，而不是现实的环境。超细致的动漫渲染、清晰的线条、闪闪发光的亮点、竖版海报构图，给人一种激进的汽水广告与偶像原画混合的感觉，混乱、可爱、高能。
items.prompt: A hyper-dynamic anime illustration of a neon cyber idol catgirl thrusting a soda bottle toward the viewer in extreme foreshortened perspective, with the bottle dominating the foreground and the character filling the background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long lavender-to-cyan gradient hair"}, 2 black cat ears with soft pink inner fur, and 1 glowing halo ring floating above her head. Her face is mostly hidden by a solid square censor block in the center-right of the image, while her wild flowing hair explodes outward in ribbons and strands. She wears a glossy black and white futuristic streetwear outfit with a deep neckline, a cropped jacket, metallic straps, small accessories, and a round pink badge near the chest. Her visible hand grips 1 plastic soda bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="Nyan SODA"}, with long nails painted in 2 colors: cyan and pink. The bottle is transparent and filled with sparkling dark purple soda, glowing bubbles, and neon highlights, and it erupts upward in a dramatic splash of vivid magenta liquid. Surround the scene with 1 shower of crystalline ice cubes, countless droplets, paint-like splashes, glittering particles, and energy arcs. Use an intense palette of electric magenta, violet, indigo, and cyan with high contrast, glossy reflections, bloom lighting, and luminous rim light. The background should be an abstract explosion of liquid, light, and motion rather than a realistic setting. Make it feel like an aggressive soda advertisement mixed with idol key art, chaotic, cute, and high-energy, with ultra-detailed anime rendering, crisp linework, sparkling highlights, and a vertical poster composition.

items.title: 冰雪麒麟女法师
items.promptZh: 一幅高度细致的动漫奇幻插图，描绘了一位身材高大、优雅的女性，类似冰雪女巫或麒麟武士，以全身四分之三后视图显示，她的头稍稍偏向一边，站在充满柔和粉红色樱花的明亮雪山风景中。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="very light icy blue"}头发，又长又密，在风中飘逸，层次分明的发丝、柔软的刘海、卷曲的发尾，头顶有一头松散的长发。两个带有微妙红色图案的深色弯曲角状饰物从她头部的两侧升起。她的脸被浅淡紫灰色调的扁平矩形模糊块遮挡。她穿着华丽的梦幻连体衣和连衣裙，颜色为黑色、白色、长春花色和宝蓝色，带有金色花丝盔甲细节：黑色贴身胸衣、分离式半透明喇叭袖和蓝色水晶般的羽毛袖口、无背白蓝色上衣、复杂的金色腰部盔甲和发光的蓝色宝石中心饰物、带有金色几何装饰的纯黑色紧身衣、分层半透明蓝色织物镶片和正好 3 个可见的红色流苏腰部和侧腰带上挂着饰物。她的右臂张开，戴着手套，悬浮着一个发光的半透明蓝色水球，里面有旋转的阴阳水流。她的周围是卷曲的水弧和冰冷的能量丝带。背景是梦幻般的空灵高山景色，右侧有一座遥远的宝塔般的塔楼，云雾缭绕的雪峰，霜冻的树木，闪闪发光的氛围，飘逸的花瓣和柔和的花簇构成了前景和左上角。使用柔和的辐射背光，虹彩高光，抛光的动漫渲染，精致的渐变，清晰的装饰服装细节，神奇的幻想情绪，凉爽的蓝色和薰衣草调色板与粉红色的口音，垂直构图，没有文字，没有额外的字符。
items.prompt: A highly detailed anime fantasy illustration of a tall elegant woman resembling an ice sorceress or qilin-inspired warrior, shown in a full-body three-quarter back view with her head turned slightly away, standing in a luminous snowy mountain landscape filled with soft pink cherry blossoms. She has {argument name="hair color" default="very light icy blue"} hair, extremely long, thick, and flowing in the wind with layered strands, soft bangs, curled tips, and a loose ahoge on top. Two dark curved horn-like ornaments with subtle red patterning rise from either side of her head. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in a pale lavender-gray tone. She wears an ornate fantasy bodysuit and dress in black, white, periwinkle, and sapphire blue with gold filigree armor details: a black fitted chest piece, detached translucent bell sleeves with blue crystal-like feather cuffs, a backless white-and-blue upper garment, intricate gold waist armor with a glowing blue gemstone centerpiece, sheer black tights with gold geometric accents, layered translucent blue fabric panels, and exactly 3 visible red tassel ornaments hanging from the waist and side sashes. Her right arm is extended with an open gloved hand, levitating a glowing translucent blue water sphere containing swirling yin-yang-like currents. Around her are curling arcs of water and icy energy ribbons. items.promptZh: 一幅非常详细的奇幻动画插图，两个年轻人斜倚在单独的透明水晶状展示盒内，并排悬挂在黑暗的戏剧空间中，分为对比鲜明的主题。左边的盒子是温暖的橄榄绿和金色色调，里面是一个冷静、优雅的年轻人，浅金色短发，皮肤苍白，黑色正装衬衫，宽松的金色条纹领带，奶油色长裤和黑色鞋子，以轻松的姿势躺着，脸旁拿着一朵小花。他的周围正好有10个可见的装饰元素：1个装满绿叶植物的牛皮纸袋、1个金属杯、1个柠檬、1个小斑马雕像、1本打开的书、1朵向日葵、拖曳的绿色藤蔓、许多漂浮的肥皂泡、玻璃上蚀刻的白色花卉图案、覆盖盒子地板的绿色植物。右边的盒子采用引人注目的深红色和黑色调色板，里面有一个淘气、自信的年轻人，他有一头凌乱的中棕色头发、苍白的皮肤、一件带有红色口音的黑色衣服和分层配饰，他抬起一只膝盖闲逛，咬着或拿着一朵红玫瑰。在他的周围，正好有10个可见的装饰元素：1个骨头般的白色骷髅装饰品，1个刻面红色宝石，1个刻面淡色宝石，1张挂在链子上的卡片或标签，1本红色书籍，托盘上1块包裹着的肉或食物，1个小狮子雕像，1个红色零食袋，盒子下面的爪状划痕，以及闪闪发光的红色水晶碎片。背景被垂直地分成两个盒子之间的星空宇宙接缝，有垂下的窗帘、一串串三角形彩旗、红色一侧淡淡的爪印图案，总共有 4 个气球：左边 2 个为白色和橄榄绿，右边 2 个为红色和黑色。通过玻璃上的戏剧性反射、丰富的高光、漂浮的颗粒、奢华的纹理、复杂的道具和怀旧的故事书氛围，使构图华丽、有光泽且具有电影感。以精美的现代动漫关键艺术风格进行渲染，超详细、优雅、梦幻且唤起情感。
items.prompt: A highly detailed fantasy anime illustration of two young men reclining inside separate transparent crystal-like display boxes suspended side by side in a dark, theatrical space, split into contrasting themes. The left box has a warm olive-green and gold palette and contains a calm, elegant young man with short light blond hair, pale skin, a black dress shirt, a loosened gold striped tie, cream trousers, and black shoes, lying in a relaxed pose while holding a small flower near his face. Around him are exactly 10 visible decorative elements: 1 brown paper bag filled with leafy green plants, 1 metal mug, 1 lemon, 1 small zebra figurine, 1 open book, 1 sunflower, trailing green vines, many floating soap bubbles, etched white floral drawings on the glass, and greenery covering the floor of the box. The right box has a dramatic crimson red and black palette and contains a mischievous, confident young man with tousled medium brown hair, pale skin, a black outfit with red accents and layered accessories, lounging with one knee raised while biting or holding a red rose. Around him are exactly 10 visible decorative elements: 1 bone-like white skeletal ornament, 1 faceted red gemstone, 1 faceted pale gemstone, 1 hanging card or tag on a chain, 1 red book, 1 wrapped piece of meat or food on a tray, 1 small lion figurine, 1 red snack bag, claw-like scratch marks beneath the box, and sparkling red crystal shards. The background is split vertically into a starry cosmic seam between the two boxes, with draped curtains, strings of triangular bunting, faint paw-print motifs on the red side, and exactly 4 balloons total: 2 on the left in white and olive green, 2 on the right in red and black. Make the composition ornate, glossy, and cinematic, with dramatic reflections on the glass, rich highlights, floating particles, luxurious textures, intricate props, and a nostalgic storybook mood. Render in polished modern anime key art style, ultra-detailed, elegant, dreamlike, and emotionally evocative.

items.promptZh: 一幅喜怒无常的黑暗奇幻动漫插图，描绘了一个受伤的年轻人，留着凌乱的短发，颓然坐在地板上，靠着有裂缝的白色石膏墙。他的脸大部分转过脸去，部分被阴影遮住，给人一种神秘而疲惫的感觉。他穿着一件宽松的黑色和服长袍，胸前敞开，露出精瘦肌肉发达的躯干，腰间系着深红色的腰带。一串长长的深红色念珠挂在他的脖子上，更多的念珠缠在一只手上，散落在地板上。他旁边放着一根华丽的黑色礼仪杖，上面有圆形的环和一个矛状的顶端，斜靠在他的肩膀上。他身后的墙上有明显的深红色血迹，并在右上角附近滴落，表明最近发生过一场战斗。前景的地板上散落着念珠、破碎的金属装饰品、几张写有黑色书法的纸质护身符或福达纸条，以及一朵红色的花。温暖的午后光线从左侧穿过场景，在长袍褶皱、手、胸部和墙壁纹理上形成强烈的高光和深色阴影。绘画般的笔触，高度细致的织物和皮肤渲染，忧郁的氛围，优雅的哥特式构图，垂直的肖像取景，电影动漫的关键视觉风格。
items.prompt: A moody dark fantasy anime illustration of a wounded young man with {argument name="hair color" default="ash blond"} short tousled hair, sitting slumped on the floor against a cracked white plaster wall. His face is mostly turned away and partially obscured in shadow, giving him a mysterious, exhausted presence. He wears a loose black kimono robe hanging open at the chest, exposing a lean muscular torso, with a deep red sash at the waist. A long strand of dark crimson prayer beads hangs around his neck, with more beads tangled in one hand and spilled across the floor. Beside him rests an ornate black ceremonial staff with circular rings and a spear-like finial, leaning diagonally against his shoulder. The wall behind him is streaked with dramatic dark red blood smears and drips near the upper right, suggesting a recent battle. On the floor in the foreground are scattered prayer beads, broken metallic ornaments, several paper talismans or ofuda slips with black calligraphy, and a single red flower. Warm late-afternoon light cuts across the scene from the left, creating strong highlights and deep shadows over the robe folds, hand, chest, and wall texture. Painterly brushwork, highly detailed fabric and skin rendering, melancholic atmosphere, elegant gothic composition, vertical portrait framing, cinematic anime key visual style.

items.title: 克苏鲁跑团夜现场
items.prompt: A richly detailed anime-style illustration of a late-night Call of Cthulhu tabletop RPG session in a dim antique study lit by warm oil lamps and candles. Three young women sit around a wooden table crowded with game materials. On the left, a girl in a military-style cap and camouflage jacket with long dark braided hair writes notes on a character sheet with a pen, looking stressed and slightly overwhelmed. In the center, a girl with very long pale lavender hair in twin buns and flowing lengths wears an elegant dark green dress with gold trim and white lace cuffs, smiling mischievously while holding up a large hardcover book titled "Talk of Cthulhu" with a dramatic occult monster cover; above her is handwritten Japanese text reading "これで全員 一時的狂気ね" with a small heart. On the right, an orange-haired girl in a white lab coat with a stethoscope and ID badge reads a paper nervously, with handwritten Japanese text above her that says "SAN値が ピンチ！" with energetic accent lines. The tabletop is packed with exactly 10 polyhedral dice scattered across the center, assorted papers, 3 visible character sheets or note pages, 4 large map sheets, 2 mugs with dark emblems, 1 glass of iced cola, 1 plate of cookies, 1 bag of potato chips labeled in Japanese, 1 small standing sign reading "発狂中", 1 black ink bottle, 1 white feather quill, 2 closed occult hardcovers stacked at the lower right, and 1 large open illustrated monster book on the right. The room behind them has tall bookshelves full of old books, framed occult artwork including a tentacled creature image, a large aged wall map with pinned markings and strings, candles, wood furniture, and a moody Victorian occult-library atmosphere. Composition is a wide cinematic group shot from slightly above table height, highly rendered, warm brown and amber lighting, intricate textures, expressive anime faces and hair, playful horror-comedy tone, premium light novel or visual novel key art quality.

items.prompt: A polished anime-style illustration of {argument name="character duo" default="Gilgamesh and Enkidu"} on a quiet park date, shown from the thighs up while walking side by side along a sunlit stone path beside a lake. The left character is a tall, slender young man with short straight {argument name="left character hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, wearing a black open overshirt, a loose white V-neck T-shirt, and beige khaki pants with both hands in his pockets. The right character is a slim and ethereal young person with very long flowing {argument name="right character hair color" default="soft green"} hair streaming to the right in the breeze, wearing an oversized white hoodie with black drawstrings and one hand gesturing naturally while walking. Their mood is gentle, intimate, and slightly romantic, like an ambiguous casual date. Place them centered in the foreground with the blond character on the left and the green-haired character on the right, both looking toward each other or slightly ahead. The background is a beautiful public park in bright late-morning or early-afternoon summer light: tall leafy trees arch overhead, creating dappled shadows on the path; a calm lake runs along the left side behind a black metal fence; a small arched bridge appears in the mid-distance; flowerbeds with white and purple blossoms line the walkway; 2 park benches are visible on the left side; 1 lamppost stands near the water; and 1 tiny distant pedestrian walks on the right side of the path. Use a vivid blue sky with small white clouds, lush greenery, high-detail foliage, soft cinematic sunlight, clean linework, and refined painterly shading. SFW, elegant, serene, visually rich anime key art, with a romantic slice-of-life atmosphere and a vertical composition.

items.prompt: A dramatic single-character fantasy illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="female East Asian swordswoman general"} in a dynamic mid-action pose against a pure black background. She is shown from the thighs up, centered and filling most of the frame, with both arms extended wide while wielding two straight swords, one thrust toward the left side of the image and one angled toward the lower right foreground. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, but the rest of the figure is rendered in exquisite detail. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose strands whipping through the air, secured with an ornate green-and-gold hair ornament. She wears elaborate {argument name="armor color" default="deep green and antique gold"} lamellar armor with richly engraved metal plates, layered sleeves, heavy bracers, a sculpted breastplate, dragon-shaped shoulder armor, a decorative waist sash, and flowing fabric ribbons and cloak panels trailing around her. The costume mixes historical Chinese-inspired warrior attire with high-fantasy nobility, covered in intricate filigree, brocade patterns, metallic edging, and embossed details. Use cinematic lighting with bright highlights on the polished blades and armor, strong contrast, crisp edges, and luxurious texture work. The composition should feel like a premium game character key visual or collectible card illustration: elegant, fierce, heroic, highly detailed, semi-realistic anime painting style, black negative space, no scenery, no extra objects, no text, square format.

items.promptZh: 一幅全身动漫插画，描绘了一个梦幻般的天女在纯白色背景上对角漂浮，从上方观看，仿佛在露天中失重。她有一头又长又飘逸的{argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"}头发，像优雅的丝带一样散布在身体周围，有光泽的亮点、松散的发丝和靠近头部一侧的星形发饰。她的脸被柔和地模糊和淡化，而构图则集中在她精致的姿势、服装和旋转的魔法氛围上。她穿着一件细节丰富的白色和蓝色水手风格梦幻连衣裙，配有半透明分层袖子、褶边荷叶边、闪闪发光的蕾丝、透明面料镶片，胸前饰有一颗大星状水晶胸针。该服装包括 5 个清晰可见的服装元素：褶边短裙、水手领和颈带、半透明分离袖或垂褶雪纺层、一条腿上的 1 条白色长筒袜、另一条腿上的 1 条深蓝色星星长筒袜以及配套的吊袜带。她赤着脚，双脚都可见。她的姿势优雅而飘逸：一臂张开向上伸，另一只手放在胸前，一腿伸直，另一腿微曲。用冷蓝色调的发光星座图案包围她，包括散布在她周围的 6 个突出的五角星装饰品、多个微小的星星闪烁、圆形水彩般的漩涡、漂浮的气泡和华丽的新月环金银丝弧线构成图像的一部分。将调色板设为冰蓝色、钴色、靛蓝色和白色，并带有闪烁的闪光纹理、柔和的半透明覆盖层、清晰的线条艺术和轻盈飘逸的光芒。整体气氛神奇、优雅、神圣、宁静，就像一位悬浮在冬日夜空中的星少女，在干净的白色画布上演绎。
items.prompt: A full-body anime illustration of a dreamy celestial girl floating diagonally across a pure white background, viewed from above as if weightless in open air. She has very long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} hair spreading in elegant ribbons around her body, with glossy highlights, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments near one side of her head. Her face is softly obscured and de-emphasized, while the composition focuses on her delicate pose, costume, and swirling magical atmosphere. She wears a highly detailed white and blue sailor-inspired fantasy dress with translucent layered sleeves, frilled ruffles, sparkling lace, sheer fabric panels, and a large star-like crystal brooch at the chest. The outfit includes 5 clearly visible clothing elements: a short frilled dress, a sailor collar and neck ribbon, semi-transparent detached sleeves or draped chiffon layers, 1 white thigh-high stocking on one leg, and 1 dark blue starry thigh-high stocking on the other leg with a matching garter band. She is barefoot, with both feet visible. Her pose is graceful and drifting: one arm reaches upward with an open hand, the other hand rests near her chest, one leg extended and the other slightly bent. Surround her with a luminous constellation motif in cool blue tones, including exactly 6 prominent five-pointed star ornaments scattered around her, multiple tiny star sparkles, circular watercolor-like swirls, floating bubbles, and ornate crescent-ring filigree arcs framing parts of the image. Make the palette icy blue, cobalt, indigo, and white, with shimmering glitter textures, soft translucent overlays, crisp line art, and a light ethereal glow. The overall mood is magical, elegant, celestial, and serene, like a star maiden suspended in a winter night sky interpreted on a clean white canvas.

items.title: 森林飞行小天使
items.prompt: {argument name="作品スタイル" default="高品質な日本アニメ風"}、ファンタジー世界。 {argument name="キャラクター" default="白い羽を持つ小さな「ちび天使（図1）」"}が、{argument name="舞台" default="不思議な森"}の中を軽やかに飛行している。ちび天使は可愛らしくデフォルメされた姿で、柔らかな光をまとった羽がほんのり発光している。 森は幻想的で、巨大な木々、ねじれた幹、宙に浮かぶ光の粒子、発光する植物やキノコが点在している。空間には淡い霧が漂い、奥行きのある神秘的な雰囲気。木漏れ日と魔法のような光が混ざり合い、夢のような世界観を演出。 カメラはちび天使を追いかけるようなダイナミックな構図で、空中を滑るように飛ぶ姿を描写。スピード感のあるモーションブラー、風の流れ、羽ばたきの軌跡を表現。 ライティングは柔らかく幻想的。緑、青、金色を基調としたカラーリング。光の粒子やボリュームライトが空間を満たす。 超高精細、シネマティック、奥行きのある構図、空気遠近法、作画良好。 テキストなし、ロゴなし、過度にリアル寄りにしない（アニメ表現を維持）。

items.prompt: A cinematic dark fantasy anime illustration in a ruined gothic cathedral, vertical composition. Show a lone female android-like warrior from behind, centered slightly low in frame, kneeling or sitting back on her heels on a reflective stone floor. She has extremely long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair spreading across the floor and air, a sleek black blindfold visor covering her eyes, and a black high-cut gothic combat dress with elegant straps, long black opera gloves, and thigh-high black boots. Her physique is slim and graceful. She holds 1 large ornate sword upright in front of her, with both hands resting on the hilt, the blade planted on the ground like a memorial. The sword has a dark blade and a decorative gold ring-like guard near the handle. The atmosphere is solemn, tragic, and reverent. Place 3 tall pointed arched windows in the background, glowing with cold white backlight through haze and dust. Include 4 stone angel statues total: 2 larger angels in the left background and 2 in the right background, partially obscured by fog and darkness. Fill the air with drifting ash, snow-like particles, black debris fragments, and a few faint orange embers near the floor. Use dramatic volumetric light rays, soft bloom, smoky mist, high contrast, and a desaturated palette of charcoal gray, silver, blue-gray, and black. The scene should feel like a memorial after a battle, highly detailed, ultra-polished, melancholic, ethereal, and game key art inspired by {argument name="franchise title" default="NieR:Automata"}. Add 1 vertical Japanese title inscription near the lower left reading {argument name="vertical text" default="儚き夢と共にあれ"}, with 1 small vertical English subtitle beside it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="NieR:Automata"}.

items.promptZh: 这是一幅精美的动漫风格肖像，照片中的{argument name="character" default="a 金发碧眼的女 VTuber-inspired 女仆"} 坐在室内一家阳光明媚的舒适咖啡馆里，从大腿上部到头部的构图略高，亲密的角度。她有一头短到中长的凌乱{argument name="hair color" default="goldenblond"}头发，层次感柔软，戴着白色褶边女仆头带，右侧戴着青色丝带发饰，上面有一个小金色饰物。她的脸大部分被向前垂下的头发遮住，创造出一种神秘的隐藏脸构图。她穿着一件优雅的黑白女仆裙，泡泡袖、白色荷叶边、金色镶边、合身紧身胸衣、白色围裙，侧面和背面有一个白色的大蝴蝶结。添加 2 个带有金色星形饰物的青色蝴蝶结：1 个位于衣领处，1 个位于手腕上。她的右手轻轻触碰胸前的蝴蝶结，左手轻轻地举到肩膀附近，抓着一缕松散的头发。在她裸露的大腿上加上一条带有小青色和金色丝带装饰的褶边蕾丝吊袜带。背景是一个光线温暖的欧式咖啡馆内部，有木梁，墙上挂着镶框的植物艺术，左边有一个模糊的蛋糕架，窗外的光线流进来，空气中闪烁着微小的灰尘般的光芒。采用柔和的金色午后灯光、浅景深、光泽细腻的织物渲染、细腻的皮肤阴影、微妙的浪漫氛围以及高度细致精致的动漫插画品质。

items.title: 夏日乡间车站少女
items.prompt: A cinematic anime-style illustration of a quiet rural Japanese train station in early summer, filled with travel nostalgia and bright midday light. In the foreground, one high school girl stands alone on the platform near the left side of the frame, facing slightly toward the viewer with a shy, gentle posture, her legs together and one foot angled inward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. She holds a dark school bag in one hand at her side. Her expression should feel calm, a little wistful, as if she was just about to speak before the train arrived. Place her beside an old weathered wooden station building with large windowpanes and a simple wooden bench. Above her is 1 hanging station sign reading {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}, with smaller romanized text “YAMANOSHITA” and small local line information beneath it. The right half of the image opens to 1 set of railway tracks receding into the distance, bordered by lush green grass and wildflowers, with 1 small local train approaching from far down the line. Add a few utility poles running alongside the tracks. In the deep background, show a dramatic mountain range with lingering snow on the peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Composition should balance the girl on the left and the railway perspective on the right, with detailed background scenery, crisp sunlight, soft anime rendering, realistic textures in the station wood and rails, and a heartfelt slice-of-life travel mood.

items.title: 冬日帐篷露营双人场景
items.titleZh: 冬日帐篷露营双人场景
items.promptZh: 一个大型米色帆布帐篷内舒适的冬季露营场景，呈现为半现实的动漫插图，具有自然采光和现实的环境细节。展示了两名年轻女性坐在一个用作露营桌的紧凑型煤油加热器周围，上面放着一个黑色的大金属锅。该视点是从略高于座位高度的角度拍摄的坦率广角照片构图，使场景感觉就像在帐篷内拍摄的休闲快照。左边的女人{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown"}头发扎成高马尾辫，刘海松散，穿着一件蓬松的棕色羊毛夹克、深色裤子和一条带有身份证的红色挂绳。她坐在一张低矮的露营椅上，身体前倾，用筷子夹住手里的小碗或食物容器。右边的女士有一头{argument name="hair color" default="black"}齐肩的头发，穿着一件柔和的紫色连帽衫，内搭黑色羽绒背心、浅灰色运动裤和深色鞋子。她坐在另一张低矮的露营椅上，一只手托着脸颊，摆出一种放松、昏昏欲睡的姿势。让两张脸都被软矩形模糊块遮挡，就像在发布的照片​​中匿名一样。在它们周围，包括场景中可见的 4 个红色饮料罐：2 个位于中心附近的木桌板上，1 个裁剪在右下前景中，1 个位于右侧附近。在加热器周围搭建一个低 U 形排列的 3 块木板凳。添加露营小细节：左侧地面上有 1 个橄榄色行李袋，左侧妇女身后有 1 个装有用品的塑料储物盒，盒子顶部有 1 个白色塑料购物袋，桌子上有 1 个小碗，右侧木板上有 1 个彩色零食包，最左侧地板上有 1 个柔软的棕色布，右后方有 1 个黑色金属架。帐篷内部应该有绷紧的帆布墙、可见的接缝和支撑杆、砾石地面和温暖柔和的调色板。保留真实露营照片的感觉，其中只有人变成了动漫风格的角色，而场景仍然高度逼真。
items.prompt: A cozy winter camping scene inside a large beige canvas tent, rendered as a semi-realistic anime illustration with natural lighting and realistic environmental detail. Show exactly 2 seated young women around a compact kerosene heater used as a camp table, with a large black metal pot resting on top. The viewpoint is a candid wide-angle photo composition from slightly above seated height, making the scene feel like a casual snapshot taken inside the tent. The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose bangs, and wears a fluffy brown fleece jacket, dark pants, and a red lanyard with an ID card. She sits in a low camping chair and leans forward, using chopsticks over a small bowl or food container in her hands. The woman on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} shoulder-length hair and wears a muted purple hoodie layered under a black puffer vest, light gray sweatpants, and dark shoes. She sits in another low camping chair, resting her cheek on one hand in a relaxed, sleepy pose. Keep both faces obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, as if anonymized in a posted photo. Around them, include exactly 4 red beverage cans visible in the scene: 2 on the wooden table planks near the center, 1 cropped in the lower right foreground, and 1 farther back near the right side. Build a low U-shaped arrangement of 3 wooden bench planks surrounding the heater. Add small camping details: 1 olive duffel bag on the left ground, 1 plastic storage box with supplies behind the left woman, 1 white plastic shopping bag on top of the box, 1 small bowl on the table, 1 colorful snack package on the right-side plank, 1 soft brown cloth on the far left floor, and 1 black metal rack frame standing at the back right. The tent interior should have taut canvas walls, visible seams and support poles, a gravel ground, and a warm muted color palette. Preserve the feeling of a real camping photo where only the people have been turned into anime-style characters while the setting remains highly realistic.

items.title: 居酒屋双人聚餐实拍
items.promptZh: 一张真实的动漫风格风格的室内餐厅照片，照片中两名年轻女性坐在舒适的日式居酒屋内一张破旧的小木桌上，居酒屋的墙壁是垂直的木板，右侧有一个透明的塑料帐篷状窗帘。相机略高于桌子高度，并与桌子成对角线，营造出一种随意的快照感觉。一位女士位于左侧前景，她的背对着观众，身体前倾在桌子上方；她有一头深色长直发，穿着一件厚重的深海军蓝或黑色羽绒服，带有大兜帽。第二位女士坐在她对面的右侧，以轻松的姿势面对镜头，一只手臂弯曲在桌子上；她有一头齐肩的深棕色到黑色的头发，中间的头发，黑色的羽绒服和浅色的内衬衬衫。仅用干净、自然的动漫人物替换人物，同时保持餐厅环境逼真且不变。保留动漫人物的混合媒体外观，可信地合成到真实照片中。桌子上有2个不锈钢马克杯、2双筷子、1部靠近桌子中左边缘的亮蓝色盒子的智能手机、1个靠近右边女士的香烟盒、1个大椭圆形盘子，里面有切成薄片的白洋葱和柠檬片、1小盘绿色蔬菜、1小盘棕色食物、1小盘烤面包或烤面包、1个小黑碗、2个小空白碗和1个印刷的手写日文菜单表位于桌子的右下角。左上方背景包括一个木制柜台，上面有白色陶瓷瓶和盘子，以及一张手写的日式墙壁菜单海报。温暖的室内灯光，日常的夜生活氛围，纪实的现实主义，细致的木纹，略显凌乱的桌面，正宗的日本休闲餐饮场景。
items.prompt: A candid indoor restaurant photo in a realistic anime-inspired style, showing two young women seated at a small worn wooden table inside a cozy Japanese izakaya with vertical wood-paneled walls and a clear plastic tent-like curtain on the right side. The camera is slightly above table height and angled diagonally toward the table, creating a casual snapshot feeling. One woman is in the left foreground with her back mostly to the viewer, leaning forward over the table; she has long straight dark hair and wears a bulky dark navy or black puffer jacket with a large hood. The second woman sits across from her on the right, facing the camera with a relaxed posture and one arm bent on the table; she has shoulder-length dark brown to black hair, a center part, a black puffer jacket, and a light inner shirt. Replace only the people with clean, natural-looking anime characters while keeping the restaurant environment photorealistic and unchanged. Preserve the mixed-media look of anime characters composited believably into a real photo. On the table, include 2 stainless steel mugs, 2 pairs of chopsticks, 1 smartphone with a bright blue case near the center-left edge of the table, 1 cigarette pack near the right woman, 1 large oval plate with thinly sliced white onions and a lemon wedge, 1 small dish of green vegetables, 1 small plate of brown food, 1 small plate with toast or grilled bread, 1 small dark bowl, 2 small empty white bowls, and 1 printed handwritten Japanese menu sheet lying on the lower right corner of the table. In the upper left background, include a wooden counter with white ceramic bottles and dishes, plus 1 handwritten Japanese wall menu poster. Warm indoor lighting, everyday nightlife atmosphere, documentary realism, detailed wood grain, slightly cluttered tabletop, authentic casual dining scene in Japan.

items.promptZh: 一张日本夜间心理恐怖游戏的电影截图，以第三人称过肩视角显示，一名身穿深色连帽夹克的年轻人站在便利店遮阳篷下，凝视着一扇大前窗。玻璃里，不是正常的倒影，而是一个可怕的人形身影，椭圆形的脑袋不自然地被拉长，黑色的长发垂在两侧，面色苍白，面无表情，穿着深色的外套，就站在他的正对面。倒影之外是日本一条湿漉漉的城市街道，被雨水浸湿的沥青光滑，稀疏的行人撑着雨伞，昏暗的店面，自动售货机，停车标志，高楼大厦以超现实的扭曲视角向内弯曲，朝向街道尽头天空中的黑暗漩涡。便利店的窗台上并排摆放着 5 个可见的杂志封面，右下角堆放着 8 个方便食品或杯面。用日语添加微妙的游戏内 UI 文本：左上角正好有 2 个目标线，左下角正好有 2 个小动作提示。包括可读的日本街头海报和商店标志，例如右上角的大型红色员工招聘标志和右下角的黄色积分活动标志。灯光极其黑暗、喜怒无常、真实，有反射、深阴影、潮湿的纹理，以及室内灯和路灯发出的微弱冷光。风格：超现实的生存恐怖视频游戏，令人不安，接地气，详细，电影化，高对比度，诡异的沉默，没有夸张的动作，没有鲜艳的色彩。
items.prompt: A cinematic Japanese psychological horror game screenshot at night, shown from a third-person over-the-shoulder perspective behind a young man wearing a dark hooded jacket, standing under a convenience store awning and staring into a large front window. In the glass, instead of a normal reflection, there is a terrifying humanoid figure with an unnaturally elongated oval head, long straight black hair hanging down both sides, a pale expressionless face, and a dark coat, standing directly opposite him. Beyond the reflection is a wet urban street in Japan with glossy rain-soaked asphalt, sparse pedestrians holding umbrellas, dim storefronts, vending machines, parking signs, and tall buildings bending inward in a surreal warped perspective toward a dark swirling vortex in the sky at the end of the street. The convenience store window ledge displays exactly 5 visible magazine covers lined up side by side and exactly 8 instant food items or cup noodles stacked on the lower right. Add subtle in-game UI text in Japanese: exactly 2 objective lines in the upper left, and exactly 2 small action prompts in the lower left. Include readable Japanese street posters and shop signs, such as a large red staff recruitment sign on the upper right and a yellow points campaign sign on the lower right. Lighting is extremely dark, moody, and realistic, with reflections, deep shadows, damp textures, and a faint cold glow from interior lights and street lamps. Style: ultra-realistic survival horror video game, unsettling, grounded, detailed, cinematic, high contrast, eerie silence, no exaggerated action, no bright colors.

items.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the top-down RPG town map into a polished anime-style event illustration from a human eye-level perspective. Keep the same village location and layout cues: the central stone well, the path network, the hedges, the wooden houses, and the narrow water canal on the left. Convert the 2 small sprite characters by the well into 2 full-size fantasy characters in the foreground: a silver-haired mage in a purple robe holding a staff, and a blonde elf in green-and-brown adventurer clothing, both leaning over and looking into the well. items.promptZh: 一幅高度详细的动画插图，描绘了一位时尚年轻女性在欧式花街优雅的白天郊游，以全身至四分之三的站立姿势。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="deep indigo blue"}头发，扎成两条非常长的双马尾，光泽柔和，发丝松散，白色玫瑰花和褶边发饰用黑色丝带系着。她穿着浪漫的白色迷你连衣裙，紧身胸衣式上身，鸡心领口，胸前有黑色蝴蝶结，分层荷叶边，戏剧性的不对称罩裙，腰部有白玫瑰装饰。她的配饰包括 1 条带白色花朵装饰的黑色项圈、1 条上臂黑色臂章、2 条白色褶边手腕袖口、2 条黑色吊袜带、2 条带蕾丝上衣的透明黑色长筒袜，以及 1 个黑色小手提包。她的表情应该给人一种精致、优雅、略带羞涩的感觉，一手挽起一绺头发，另一只手拿着包。将她安置在阳光明媚的鹅卵石购物巷中，两旁是精品橱窗、花盆和柔和的彩色建筑，还有两个明显的标志，上面写着“玫瑰镇”和“玫瑰花园”。使用明亮的春天灯光、凉爽的蓝紫色阴影、闪闪发光的高光、丰富的花卉细节以及精美的绘画动漫风格，并具有梦幻、精致、高端的插图效果。
items.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration of a fashionable young woman on an elegant daytime outing in a European-style flower street, shown in a full-body to three-quarter standing pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep indigo blue"} hair styled in 2 very long twin-tails with soft shine, loose strands, and white rose-and-frill hair accessories tied with black ribbons. She wears a romantic white mini dress with a fitted corset-like bodice, sweetheart neckline, black bow at the chest, layered ruffles, a dramatic asymmetrical overskirt, and white rose decorations at the waist. Her accessories include 1 black choker with a white flower ornament, 1 black armband on the upper arm, 2 white frilled wrist cuffs, 2 black garter straps, 2 sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace tops, and she carries 1 small black handbag. Her expression should feel delicate, elegant, and slightly shy, with one hand lifting a lock of hair and the other holding the bag. Set her in a sunlit cobblestone shopping lane lined with boutique windows, flower planters, and soft pastel architecture, with 2 visible signs reading "Rose Town" and "Rose Garden". Use luminous spring lighting, cool blue-violet shadows, sparkling highlights, abundant floral details, and a polished painterly anime style with a dreamy, refined, high-end illustration finish.
items.author: KenT🌸

items.title: 紫发动漫头像肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅居中的动漫风格半身像，描绘的是一位雌雄同体的年轻人，面朝前方，背景是干净的浅灰白色背景。该构图是方形的，设计得像社交媒体图标。该角色有一头中等长度的分层直发，中间部分大部分是黑色，带有光泽的深紫色亮点，下部和发尖染成鲜艳的紫色。松散的发丝修饰脸型，头发垂至肩部。脸部被中央的一个大的软边方形模糊块故意遮挡，颜色为柔和的紫灰色，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和大部分面部特征，同时使下巴线和颈部部分可见。仅在模糊边缘周围显示一点苍白的皮肤。右侧可见的耳朵装饰有多个银色穿孔，包括小圈、耳钉和带有链条细节的悬挂十字耳环。这套服装是深色单色街头服饰，带有微妙的哥特美学：黑色高领拉链内层完全拉链至喉咙，黑色超大半光夹克叠在上面，一个肩上有一条带有矩形金属扣的黑色肩带，另一肩上有一个细链条配件。添加一条长长的银项链，胸前中央挂着一个十字架吊坠。灯光柔和且漫射，具有抛光的数字绘画细节和半真实的动画渲染。意境酷炫、时尚、略带神秘、另类。在背景中，添加稀疏的极简主义网络故障口音：几个细长的竖条和淡青色、淡紫色、洋红色和深蓝色的微小矩形像素散布在人物周围，加上右上角附近的一个微弱的四点闪光。保持背景整洁、通风，角色占据画面的大部分。
items.prompt: A centered anime-style bust portrait of an androgynous young person facing forward against a clean pale gray-white background. The composition is square and designed like a social media icon. The character has medium-length layered straight hair with a center part, mostly black with glossy deep violet highlights and vivid purple-dyed lower sections and tips. Loose strands frame the face and the hair falls to the shoulders. The face is intentionally obscured by a large soft-edged square blur block in the center, tinted muted mauve-gray, covering the eyes, nose, and most facial features while leaving the jawline and neck partly visible. Show only a small hint of pale skin around the edges of the blur. The visible ear on the right side is decorated with multiple silver piercings, including small hoops, studs, and a dangling cross earring with chain details. The outfit is dark monochrome streetwear with a subtle goth aesthetic: a black high-neck zip-up inner layer fully zipped to the throat, a black oversized semi-gloss jacket layered over it, a black strap with a rectangular metal buckle over one shoulder, and a thin chain accessory over the other shoulder. Add a long silver necklace with a cross pendant hanging at the center of the chest. Lighting is soft and diffuse, with polished digital painting detail and semi-realistic anime rendering. The mood is cool, stylish, slightly mysterious, and alternative. In the background, add sparse minimalist cyber-glitch accents: several thin vertical bars and tiny rectangular pixels in pastel cyan, lavender, magenta, and dark blue scattered around the figure, plus one faint four-point sparkle near the upper right side. Keep the background uncluttered and airy, with the character occupying most of the frame.

items.promptZh: 令人惊叹的肖像格式动漫戏剧电影海报。吉卜力工作室遇见新海诚视觉语言。一名身着破烂白色巫女长袍的少女站在一座摇摇欲坠的巨型石神的翅膀上——这是一座长满青苔和发光的金色汉字的古老巨像，在云海中缓缓坠落。她长长的黑发抵抗重力向上飘逸。她将一只手伸向天空，一道巨大的天裂撕裂了天空——天裂之外，一片倒转的海洋漂浮在云层之上，古老的木城倒挂在其表面，灯笼像星星一样飘浮。天空从底部的深暮蓝色过渡到顶部的发光桃色和玫瑰金色。体积神射线穿透云层。樱花花瓣和撕碎的护身符纸到处盘旋。她的表情是冷静而坚定。美术风格：手绘2D动画，超细致的背景画，富有表现力的线条，丰富的卡通渲染。调色板：深靛蓝、桃色、玫瑰金、暖琥珀色、柔和的白色。标题采用大而优雅的{argument name="language" default=" Japanese kanji"}，位于底部，下方是干净的现代字体的英文字幕。标题上方的白色小斜体文字标语。情绪：神话、精神、苦乐参半的奇迹。影院上映品质，东宝电影公司。
items.prompt: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. She reaches one hand toward the sky where a vast celestial rift tears open the heavens — beyond it, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, ancient wooden cities hanging upside down from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from deep twilight blue at the bottom to a luminous peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric god rays pierce through cloud layers. Cherry blossom petals and torn paper talismans spiral everywhere. Her expression is calm determination. Art style: hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive linework, rich cel shading. Palette: deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. Title in large elegant {argument name="language" default="Japanese kanji"} at the bottom with English subtitle beneath in a clean modern font. Tagline in small white italic text above the title. Mood: mythological, spiritual, bittersweet wonder. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

items.promptZh: 一幅宁静的动漫风格夏季肖像，一位年轻女子站在户外，在鲜艳的蓝天下，画面边缘附近可见 4 个柔软的白云簇，空气中还有一些闪闪发光的小光点。她以低角度拍摄，从腰部以上取景，稍微转向一侧，平静地看着观众，表情温柔、安静。她有一头又长又直的{argument name="hair color" default="very dark indigo-black"}头发，齐刘海遮住额头，许多松散的发丝在风中戏剧性地向右飘逸，柔软的棕灰色大眼睛，苍白的皮肤，脸颊上有淡淡的红晕。她戴着一顶深色带子的宽边天然稻草遮阳帽，穿着一件简单的无袖白色夏装，上面有细肩带和极简的细节。灯光是明亮的正午阳光，带有柔和的动画渲染、微妙的边缘光、干净的线条、精致的渐变和梦幻般的抛光插图风格。气氛轻快、怀旧、优雅、宁静，背景是天空，没有建筑物或其他物体。
items.prompt: A serene anime-style summer portrait of a young woman standing outdoors under a vivid blue sky with 4 soft white cloud clusters visible near the frame edges and a few tiny sparkling light specks in the air. She is shown from a low angle, framed from about the waist up, slightly turned to the side while looking calmly toward the viewer with a gentle, quiet expression. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="very dark indigo-black"} hair with full blunt bangs covering the forehead and many loose strands flowing dramatically to the right in the wind, large soft brown-gray eyes, pale skin, and a faint blush on her cheeks. She wears a wide-brimmed natural straw sunhat with a dark band and a simple sleeveless white summer dress with thin straps and minimal detail. Lighting is bright midday sunlight with soft cel-shaded anime rendering, subtle rim light, clean linework, delicate gradients, and a dreamy polished illustration style. The mood is airy, nostalgic, elegant, and peaceful, with the sky filling the background and no buildings or other objects.

items.prompt: A dramatic anime-style summer scene viewed from an extreme low angle with strong foreshortening: a young woman in a flowing white sundress and a wide-brim straw hat stands on a sunlit country path and reaches one hand directly toward the camera, her open palm dominating the foreground in exaggerated perspective as if inviting the viewer to take her hand. She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="deep black"} hair streaming powerfully sideways in the wind, and a white ribbon tied to the hat also whips through the air. Her dress is sleeveless, softly pleated, light and breezy, cinched at the waist with a fabric bow on one side, with glossy sunlight highlights on her skin and fabric. The composition emphasizes motion, scale, and cinematic depth, with the character towering against a vivid cobalt summer sky filled with a few wispy cloud streaks and puffy white clouds near the horizon. Place her on a paved rural walkway bordered by rustic wooden fences on both sides, with green fields and distant low mountains in the background. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with painterly detail, saturated colors, bright midday lighting, high contrast, ultra-clean linework, and a sense of awe and freedom. No text, no additional characters, single-subject illustration.

items.title: 彩虹兔耳DJ少女
items.promptZh: 充满活力的动漫风格 DJ 女孩，具有可爱、梦幻的狂欢美学，以专业 DJ 控制器后面的特写上半身构图为中心。她头带上戴着超大的彩虹兔子耳朵，戴着大彩虹包耳式耳机，一只手按下右侧耳机罩，另一只手触摸左侧转盘，仿佛在提示下一首曲目。使用略低的角度仰视她，营造一种充满活力、情感丰富的表演情绪。给她剪一个带有钝刘海的短直波波头，发型为{argument name="hair color" default="pastelblond with Rainbow-tinted Ends"}。她的脸应该呈现出俏皮的 DJ 表情：一只眼睛眨着眼睛，露出顽皮的笑容，就好像她即将停止节奏一样。给她穿上一件白色连帽衫，袖口有彩虹条纹，胸前和袖子上有两个红色的心形小补丁。 DJ 设置应包括 2 个转盘、1 个中央混音器部分、4 个垂直通道推子、3 个 EQ 旋钮行和 2 个带有发光波形图形的小显示屏。用柔和的淡紫色到粉色渐变、微小的闪光、漂浮的柔和的心形以及散布在角色周围的 6 个彩色音符图标填充背景。以抛光、光泽、高细节的动漫插画风格渲染，带有发光的彩虹灯光、柔和的阴影、干净的线条艺术、饱和的色彩、可爱的偶像与俱乐部的能量，以及额外的情感、神奇的“情绪”氛围。
items.prompt: A vibrant anime-style DJ girl in a cute, dreamy rave aesthetic, centered in a close-up upper-body composition behind a professional DJ controller. She wears oversized rainbow bunny ears on a headband and large rainbow over-ear headphones, with one hand pressing the right headphone cup and the other hand touching the left turntable as if cueing the next track. Use a slightly low-angle viewpoint looking up at her to create an energetic, emotional performance mood. Give her a short straight bob haircut with blunt bangs in {argument name="hair color" default="pastel blonde with rainbow-tinted ends"}. Her face should show a playful DJ expression: one eye winking and a wide mischievous grin, as if she is about to drop the beat. Dress her in a white hoodie with rainbow-striped cuffs and two small red heart patches on the chest and sleeve. The DJ setup should include exactly 2 turntables, 1 central mixer section, 4 vertical channel faders, 3 EQ knob rows, and 2 small display screens with glowing waveform-like graphics. Fill the background with a soft lavender-to-pink gradient, tiny sparkles, floating pastel hearts, and exactly 6 colorful music-note icons scattered around the character. Render it in polished, glossy, high-detail anime illustration style with luminous rainbow lighting, soft shading, clean line art, saturated colors, cute idol-meets-club energy, and an extra emotive, magical, “emo” atmosphere.
items.author: miya / MYST（みや／ミスト）

items.title: 魔法电音DJ少女
items.promptZh: 一个充满活力的动漫风格特写镜头，展示了一个可爱的 DJ 女孩在神奇的狂欢场景中，从略低的角度拍摄，就好像观众站在 DJ 台前一样。她留着鲍勃短发，留着{argument name="hair color" default="blonde with Rainbow-dyed Ends"}，蓬松的刘海和高高的兔子耳朵，左耳内侧呈现彩虹渐变。她的脸大部分被柔和的米粉色居中的矩形检查块遮挡，但这个姿势应该暗示着顽皮的眨眼和顽皮的笑容。她头顶戴着超大心形太阳镜，一蓝一红框，镜片是有光泽的紫色。一只手将一个巨大的彩虹色耳机罩压在她的耳朵上，而另一只手臂向前伸向 DJ 控制台上的观众，营造出一种充满活力的表演感觉，就好像她即将放下下一首曲目一样。她穿着一件超大的白色连帽衫，胸前有一个大的绿色蝴蝶徽章，袖子和肩部有 4 个缝制的心形补丁：1 个橙色、1 个紫色、1 个蓝色和 1 个红色。在前景中，显示了发光 DJ 混音器的一部分，带有彩色霓虹灯控件、旋钮和发光的粉红色心形图标。背景是一个梦幻般、超级闪亮的俱乐部幻想，充满了发光的星星、心形、闪光散景、柔和的光束和柔和的彩虹亮点，具有“情绪”但卡哇伊的氛围。使用高度精美的动漫插图、光泽的灯光、柔和的光晕、虹彩反射、饱和的彩虹色调以及可爱、充满活力的偶像 DJ 美学。
items.prompt: A vibrant anime-style close-up of a cute DJ girl in a magical rave scene, framed from a slightly low angle as if the viewer is standing in front of the DJ booth. She has a short bob haircut with {argument name="hair color" default="blonde with rainbow-dyed ends"}, fluffy bangs, and tall bunny ears, with the inner left ear showing a rainbow gradient. Her face is mostly obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in soft beige-pink, but the pose should imply a playful wink and a mischievous grin. She wears oversized heart-shaped sunglasses on top of her head, one blue frame and one red frame, with glossy purple-tinted lenses. One hand is pressing a large rainbow-colored headphone cup against her ear, while the other arm reaches forward toward the viewer over the DJ console, creating an energetic performance feel as if she is about to drop the next track. She is dressed in an oversized white hoodie with a large green butterfly emblem on the chest and 4 stitched heart patches on the sleeves and shoulder area: 1 orange, 1 purple, 1 blue, and 1 red. In the foreground, show part of a glowing DJ mixer with colorful neon controls, knobs, and a luminous pink heart icon. The background is a dreamy, hyper-sparkly club fantasy filled with glowing stars, hearts, glitter bokeh, pastel light beams, and soft rainbow highlights, with an "emo" yet kawaii atmosphere. Use highly polished anime illustration, glossy lighting, soft bloom, iridescent reflections, saturated rainbow accents, and a cute, energetic idol-DJ aesthetic.

items.title: 像素风热带鹦鹉
items.promptZh: 像素艺术风格的马赛克插图，一只热带鹦鹉栖息在茂密的丛林树叶中间的棕色短树枝上，仿佛是由紧密均匀的彩色小瓷砖方形网格组装而成，每个方形周围都有细长的黑色轮廓。这只鸟的侧面侧面朝右，有一个大而弯曲的黑色喙，浅奶油色的脸，明亮的红橙色前额和喉咙，鲜艳的黄色脖子，明亮的绿色身体，长翅膀和尾羽呈饱和的蓝色和青色。鹦鹉垂直居中，稍偏左，直立在树枝上，尾巴向下延伸。鸟儿周围覆盖着郁郁葱葱的层状叶子，有多种绿色色调，从深森林绿色到石灰绿色，填满整个画面，看不到天空。使用强烈的对比度、清晰的黑色轮廓和鹦鹉后面发光的浅绿色区域，将其与较暗的树叶分开。整体图像应该看起来像复古像素艺术或彩色玻璃马赛克、高度详细、色彩丰富、方形格式和边到边平铺纹理。
items.prompt: A pixel-art style mosaic illustration of a tropical parrot perched on a short brown branch in the middle of dense jungle foliage, created as if assembled from a tight uniform square grid of tiny colored tiles with thin dark outlines around every square. The single bird is shown in side profile facing right, with a large curved black beak, a pale cream face, a bright red-orange forehead and throat, a vivid yellow neck, a bright green body, and long wings and tail feathers in saturated blue and cyan. The parrot is centered vertically and slightly left of center, standing upright on the branch, with the tail extending downward. Surround the bird with lush layered leaves in many shades of green, from deep forest green to lime, filling the entire frame with no sky visible. Use strong contrast, crisp black contouring, and a glowing light green area behind the parrot to separate it from the darker foliage. The overall image should look like retro pixel art or stained-glass mosaic, highly detailed, colorful, square format, and edge-to-edge tiled texture.
items.author: Andrew Mayne

In the top right, place small blue issue text reading {argument name="issue date" default="May 2026"} above a larger blue number line reading "No.128" with a thin underline. To the right of the car stands a slim anime-style {argument name="companion character" default="blue-haired girl"}, full body, facing left toward the car, short muted blue bob haircut with a small tied section in back, minimalist facial detail, white long-sleeve top, pale blue skirt, white socks, blue sneakers, and a blue shoulder bag, posed casually with one arm bent near her chest. Use a refined blend of soft cel-shaded anime illustration and realistic automotive rendering, with lots of negative space and elegant print-layout balance. Add large red Japanese cover text on the left in two lines reading {argument name="main cover line" default="赤いランチア・ストラトス"}, with a smaller blue Japanese subheading beneath it reading "伝説のラリーカーを、イラストで楽しむ。" Add another small blue line reading "特集 / CLASSIC SPORTS" and a handwritten-style light red note saying "with blue-haired girl". Keep the overall aesthetic minimal, sophisticated, airy, and poster-like, with soft daylight shadows and a high-end Japanese magazine cover composition.

items.title: 雨夜少女电影海报
items.prompt: Create an emotional Japanese movie trailer banner poster in a tall vertical composition, cinematic anime illustration style, set on a rainy nighttime city street in Japan filled with wet asphalt reflections, neon shop signs, and softly blurred high-rise buildings receding into the distance. In the center foreground, show 1 young anime girl in side profile facing left, standing alone under 1 transparent plastic umbrella with visible raindrops. She has long dark purple hair tied in a high ponytail, a slightly melancholic expression, and wears an oversized teal hoodie layered under a loose pink-and-teal plaid jacket. The mood is lonely, wistful, and dramatic, like a heartfelt live-action Japanese film advertisement reimagined as anime key art. Use cool blue and cyan tones with pink neon accents, glossy rain reflections, shallow depth of field, soft atmospheric haze, and subtle rim lighting from street signs. Add large handwritten white Japanese title text at the top reading {argument name="title text" default="AIの涙"}, with 1 smaller white subtitle line beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="彼女は、なぜ泣いたのか。"}. At the bottom, add 1 bold white release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2024年秋 全国ロードショー"}. Keep the character as the emotional focal point, framed mid-shot from about waist up, umbrella arcing over her head, with the empty rain-soaked street behind her emphasizing isolation and cinematic sadness.

Her outfit is an elaborate black and red punk-idol costume with a black lace-trimmed cropped top, a red tartan frilled mini skirt, many gold chains, heart and bell charms, belts, buckles, garters, and layered accessories. She also has a fluffy pink cat tail visible behind her. Her expression should feel energetic, flirty, and commanding like a live pop-rock performance. The stage is packed with concert lighting trusses, purple and magenta spotlights, glowing bokeh, stairs behind her, 2 large black stage monitors in the foreground, and 3 visible venue screens showing her live image from different angles. Include 2 visible neon signs reading {argument name="sign text" default="Neko Otome"}, one on a large screen in the upper left and one glowing pink on the front-right speaker, both accompanied by cute cat-face iconography. The crowd at the bottom right glows with pink light sticks. Use ultra-detailed polished anime rendering, glossy fabrics, metallic highlights, vivid pink-purple-red lighting, crisp linework, high contrast, and the high-energy atmosphere of a sold-out arena concert for {argument name="idol name" default="Neko Otome"}.

items.prompt: A warm, golden-hour anime illustration of a fashionable high school gyaru girl standing in an empty classroom, leaning slightly forward between wooden desks with one hand resting on a desk and the other tucked into her cardigan pocket. She has long, voluminous wavy {argument name="hair color" default="bleached blonde"} hair with soft shine and layered strands, a trendy, approachable gal aesthetic, and multiple ear piercings with delicate jewelry. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat square censor block in the center of the image. She wears a Japanese school uniform consisting of 4 visible outfit pieces: a loose cream-beige cardigan with buttons, a white shirt with the collar open, a large navy plaid ribbon bow, and a short dark plaid pleated skirt. Add subtle accessories including 2 necklaces and manicured nails. The classroom is lit by strong sunset light streaming from tall windows on the left, casting long warm shadows across the desks, floor, and her clothes. In the background, show a green chalkboard with handwritten Japanese farewell-style messages including "ありがとう♡" and "ございました!", plus a few small doodles, and several neatly arranged desks and chairs. The mood should be soft, nostalgic, flirtatious, and kindhearted, capturing the feeling of an otaku-friendly gal after school. Highly detailed anime painting, soft rim light, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, polished linework, luminous hair highlights, realistic fabric folds, and a vertical portrait framing.

items.prompt: 生成一张 9:16 竖版手机截图风格的真实抖音直播间画面，主题是{argument name="直播主题" default="《凡人修仙传》三位人物直播卖法宝"}。三人同框，从左到右的人物气质分别参考韩立、紫灵、玄骨，但不要显示角色名字，也不要做成二次元立绘，要像真人感很强的修仙主播。服装、妆造和气质保留东方修仙风格，同时符合真实直播镜头效果。当前展示商品是{argument name="展示商品" default="“天雷竹”"}，放在画面中央偏前景重点展示，商品卡或直播信息区清楚显示“天雷竹”和{argument name="商品价格" default="“9999块灵石”"}。天雷竹要有珍稀灵宝质感，竹体细节清晰，带轻微真实的雷电气息，不要夸张特效。直播间氛围非常热闹，要有真实抖音直播 UI、弹幕、点赞、在线人数、直播标识和商品卡。弹幕里大量出现《凡人修仙传》相关人物昵称刷屏，像真实粉丝互动。整体效果必须像中国真实热门抖音带货直播截图，真实、热闹、有手机截图感。不要像动漫插画，不要像电影海报，不要像游戏宣传图，不要英文 UI，不要过强魔法爆炸特效。

items.title: 赛博哥特精灵女战士
items.promptZh: 一幅黑色超详细动漫网络哥特式肖像，描绘了一个{argument name="character type" default="female elf Warriors"}的四分之三侧面轮廓，从大腿上部到头部，站在一座废弃的未来工业城市中。她有一头短而钝的鲍勃，{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}，苍白的皮肤，长而尖的精灵耳朵，表情冷静冷酷，一只明显发光的{argument name="eye color" default="crimson red"}眼睛。她的头发被风吹过脸庞，太阳穴附近戴着黑色星形金属发饰。服装是一件时尚的黑色生物力学装甲连衣裙，具有光滑的黑曜石表面、尖刺和分层板、肩膀和胸部周围撕裂的蕾丝状纹理以及复杂的恶魔外骨骼细节。一只手臂被重装成巨大的有机机械手套。她握着或融合了一把巨大的锯齿状活剑，从左下前景斜向她的躯干；这把剑是黑色金属制成的，上面有发光的纹理，嵌入了红色的核心，猛烈的熔化能量像液体火焰一样在其中爆发。红色能量丝带、火花、烟雾和余烬状粒子在她的身体和武器周围旋转。背景是一个垂直的反乌托邦巨型结构，里面充满了黑色钢塔、电缆、悬挂的链条、红色全息代码的碎片、神秘技术徽章和微弱的工业符号，所有这些都被阴影吞没了。使用黑色和深红色调色板，具有极端的对比度、光泽高光、锐利的边缘光、头后戏剧性的背光、密集的细节、混乱的绘画效果和严峻的世界末日氛围。构图应该感觉像优质的黑暗幻想关键艺术，高度抛光，电影化，令人生畏，优雅且具有爆炸性。
items.prompt: A dark ultra-detailed anime cyber-gothic portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="female elf warrior"} in a three-quarter side profile, framed from upper thighs to head, standing in a ruined futuristic industrial city. She has a short blunt bob in {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}, pale skin, long sharp elf ears, and a calm cold expression with one visible glowing {argument name="eye color" default="crimson red"} eye. Her hair is windswept across her face, and she wears a black star-shaped metallic hair ornament near one temple. Outfit is a sleek black biomechanical armored dress with glossy obsidian surfaces, spiked and layered plates, torn lace-like textures around the shoulders and chest, and intricate demonic exoskeleton detailing. One arm is heavily armored into a massive organic-mechanical gauntlet. She holds or merges with an enormous jagged living sword crossing diagonally from the lower left foreground toward her torso; the blade is black metal with glowing veins, embedded red cores, and violent molten energy bursting through it like liquid fire. Red energy ribbons, sparks, smoke, and ember-like particles swirl around her body and weapon. The background is a vertical dystopian megastructure filled with black steel towers, cables, hanging chains, fragments of red holographic code, occult-tech insignias, and faint industrial symbols, all mostly swallowed by shadow. Use a black and deep crimson palette with extreme contrast, glossy highlights, sharp rim light, dramatic backglow behind the head, dense detail, chaotic painterly effects, and a grim apocalyptic atmosphere. Composition should feel like premium dark fantasy key art, highly polished, cinematic, intimidating, elegant, and explosive.

items.title: 赛博朋克女巫与恶魔
items.promptZh: 夜晚，一个戏剧性的动漫风格的赛博朋克女巫站在一座黑暗的屋顶上，高高地俯瞰着一座密集的未来城市，从稍微升高的角度观看。主角是一位身材娇小的年轻女巫，皮肤苍白，留着冰蓝色的短发，尖尖的耳朵，红红的眼睛，带着狡黠自信的微笑。她右手举起一根黑色魔杖，顶端悬挂着一个悬挂着的球体咒语，发出淡淡的紫色和红色光芒。她的超大号歪女巫帽是黑色的，带有紫色衬里，上面布满了缝制补丁、警告标签、带子和白色图形，包括一个大的“404”和一个骷髅徽章。她穿着一套黑色和紫色的科技服装：带有许多肩带和标签的超大连帽夹克、胸前带有“404”字样的黑色短上衣、分层腰带、短裤、一条腿上的渔网、黑色系带作战靴、颈链和金属配饰。一些吊带和标签上明显写有“WITCH 404”、“404”等字样，以及以故障为主题的标记。在她的下方和旁边，一个巨大的发光紫色魔法阵与黑客界面美学混合在一起投射在屋顶地板上，充满了神秘的戒指、印记、中央骷髅符号和分散的霓虹灯系统文本（如错误代码片段），创造了魔法和数字腐败的融合。从圆圈中出现的是一个巨大的装甲召唤人物：一个黑色的未来派恶魔骑士或机器人，熟悉锯齿状的反光盔甲，狭窄的紫色发光面罩，单手握着重型武器，部分溶解成紫色能量碎片和烟雾。背景展示了一座庞大的多雨大城市，里面有公寓楼和工业屋顶，到处都是窗户、阳台、电缆、标志和薄雾。附近的建筑墙上有一个巨大的垂直涂鸦式标牌，上面有 3 个可读元素：“404”、“女巫”和“错误未找到”，再加上一个较小的“E404”。额外的紫色霓虹灯故障文本和符号散布在屋顶和空中。使用黑色、靛蓝和深紫色的深色调色板，带有鲜明的洋紫色高光、电影对比度、反光湿表面、密集的细节和高端抛光插图风格。气氛神秘、前卫、时尚、危险，融合了都市奇幻、黑客美学和魔法召唤。
items.prompt: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.

items.title: 动漫人群视角对比图
items.promptZh: 黑色背景上的两面板比较图形，展示了动漫风格的拥挤街道场景中摄像机角度的戏剧性变化。在顶部居中放置一个大的白色句子：“{argument name=”headline text”default=”将相机 POV 移动到人群中的地面位置。”}”。在左侧，添加两个与面板对齐的大白色标签：上面板旁边的“源”和下面板旁边的“输出”。创建 2 个以画布为中心的堆叠矩形图像面板。在顶部面板中，以手绘动漫电影风格展示了密密麻麻的历史街道人群的高角度俯视图，数十人挤在马车和车轮周围；包括捆绑的行李、帽子、柔和的大地色服装、蓝色和棕褐色的服装，以及人物在各个方向重叠的繁忙构图。在底部面板中，重新创建相同类型的场景，但将摄像机转移到人群内部的低地面视角，观察尸体之间以及右侧边缘的一个大马车车轮旁边。前景应该让人感觉身临其境和局促，有几个靠近镜头的弯腰或蹲着的人物，左边前景有一个穿着柔和紫色长袍的人，靠近中央底部有一个跪着或驼背的棕褐色人物，中间偏右有一个穿着浅蓝色连衣裙或外套的女人抱着一个小孩在人群中转身。将环境保持为混乱的旧世界市场或交通街道，有马匹、马车、戴着檐帽、穿着简单古装的人们、尘土飞扬的地面和温暖柔和的色彩。使用柔和的电影动画灯光、绘画式阴影以及经典吉卜力工作室人群序列的视觉感觉。整个图像应该被解读为相机实验前后的对比，上面的面板是原始的俯视构图，下面的面板是转换后的低角度透视图。
items.prompt: A two-panel comparison graphic on a black background demonstrating a dramatic camera-angle change in an anime-style crowded street scene. Place a large white sentence centered across the top: "{argument name="headline text" default="Move the camera POV to be at ground level in the crowd."}". On the left side, add two large white labels aligned with the panels: "Source" beside the upper panel and "Output" beside the lower panel. Create exactly 2 stacked rectangular image panels centered on the canvas. In the top panel, show a high-angle overhead view of a densely packed historical street crowd in a hand-painted anime film style, with dozens of people pressed together around horse-drawn carts and wagon wheels; include bundled luggage, hats, muted earth-tone clothing, blue and tan garments, and a busy composition where figures overlap in every direction. In the bottom panel, recreate the same type of scene but shift the camera to a low, ground-level point of view inside the crowd, looking between bodies and beside a large wagon wheel on the right edge. The foreground should feel immersive and cramped, with several bent or crouched figures close to the camera, a person in a muted purple robe on the left foreground, a kneeling or hunched figure in tan near the center bottom, and a woman in a light blue dress or coat toward the right-middle turning through the crowd while holding a small child. Keep the environment as a chaotic old-world market or transit street with horses, carts, people in brimmed hats and simple period clothing, dusty ground, and warm subdued colors. Use soft cinematic anime lighting, painterly shading, and the visual feel of a classic Studio Ghibli crowd sequence. The overall image should read as a before-and-after camera experiment, with the upper panel as the original overhead composition and the lower panel as the transformed low-angle perspective.

items.titleZh: 主题乐园街机对战截图
items.prompt:
Create a hyper-detailed comedic Japanese arcade fighting game screenshot styled like a versus battle scene, using a real-world photo aesthetic with game UI overlaid on top. The scene shows an intense mock battle between two groups of theme-park fans competing for the front row at an outdoor show plaza in Tokyo DisneySea. Use a wide 16:9 composition. In the background, clearly show Mediterranean Harbor and Mount Prometheus under bright daytime skies, with the waterfront and DisneySea architecture visible. In the foreground, show exactly 10 young adult people in winter casual clothing, split into 2 opposing teams of 5, physically leaning, grabbing, reaching, and shoving in a tug-of-war-like scrum over position, with exaggerated competitive body language and frozen action as if in a fighting game. Faces should be anonymized with soft blurred blocks. Add floating character labels above each person with levels and names in Japanese. The overall tone is absurdly realistic, like a real candid photo transformed into a polished arcade game battle screen.

Add a full Japanese fighting-game HUD with glossy blue-versus-red interface styling. At the very top, place a center stage title bar reading "東京ディズニーシー　ミッキー広場　ショー最前列バトル" and a large timer in the middle reading "TIME 89". In the top left, add a blue team header "PLAYER1" and team name "最前列ガチ勢A". In the top right, add a red team header "RIVAL" and team name "ライバルグループB". On the left side, stack exactly 5 blue player status panels with portraits, level, Japanese class-like nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST meters. The 5 left-side labels are: "Lv.25 ガチ勢リーダー ユウキ", "Lv.24 筋肉マン タケシ", "Lv.23 眼鏡オタク シンジ", "Lv.23 開角心MAX ケント", "Lv.22 サポート要員 リョウ". On the right side, stack exactly 5 red rival status panels with the labels: "Lv.27 ライバルリーダー ダイキ", "Lv.26 パワフル代表 マサル", "Lv.24 戦略家 コウジ", "Lv.23 熱血漢 リク", "Lv.22 サポート女子 サキ". Each panel should include numeric HP and SP values and segmented BURST gauges, styled like a Japanese arcade RPG-fighter interface.

Place exactly 10 in-battle nameplates above the fighters in the center scene, color-coded blue for the left team and red for the right team. The 10 labels are: "Lv.24 タケシ", "Lv.25 ユウキ", "Lv.23 シンジ", "Lv.23 ケント", "Lv.22 リョウ", "Lv.27 ダイキ", "Lv.26 マサル", "Lv.23 リク", "Lv.22 サキ", "Lv.22 ミサキ".

At the lower left, add a skill menu titled "スキル" listing exactly 5 skills with SP costs: "ダッシュ突撃 SP 20", "肩押し強奪 SP 25", "荷物で場所確保 SP 15", "ロープくぐり SP 10", "本気の根性 SP 50". Beneath that, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "本気の根性" with the Japanese text: "気合で相手を威圧し、どかす！ 一定時間、相手が怯みやすくなる！ （バーストゲージを大きく消費する） 効果時間：10秒".

At the bottom center, add an item menu titled "アイテム" with exactly 5 item slots showing icons and counts: a water bottle "x3", a folded purple towel "x2", a blue drawstring bag "x1", a gray backpack "x1", and a boxed meal "x2". items.title: 暗黑奇幻群像封面
items.prompt: 请根据【主题：{argument name="角色名" default="写人物名字"}】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。【基础设定】主题：{argument name="场景主题" default="咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团"}作品名：[作品名]系列名 / 品牌名：[品牌名或系列名]副标题：[副标题]风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉"}主色调：墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色点缀色：血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电画幅比例：2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版【画面结构】采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。【构图方式】整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。【视觉风格】整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。【画面目标】最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。
