items.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime illustration of a serene young woman in a moonlit spring garden beside a pond, rendered in delicate Japanese fantasy style with flat anime coloring, no shadows, ultra-clean linework, and no grainy texture. She is seated in three-quarter back view at the water’s edge, turning her face slightly toward the viewer with a calm, melancholic expression. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft bangs and floral ornaments woven into a blossom crown. She wears an elegant flowing kimono in pale blue and cream, richly patterned with stylized waves and white foxes, with layered fabric pooling around her. A large traditional paper parasol rests behind her on the right side, partly open, with dangling crystal-like ornaments. Surround her with dense blooming cherry blossom branches overhead and scattered petals in the foreground. The pond is filled with exactly 10 glowing lotus flowers floating on reflective water and exactly 4 visible koi fish swimming near the surface. In the distant left background, include a small multi-tier pagoda silhouette across the water. From the upper left, a soft rainbow beam of light descends diagonally onto the pond, creating iridescent reflections. Hang several faceted crystal ornaments from the branches so they sparkle in the light. Use a palette dominated by lavender, blush pink, pale blue, ivory, and soft gold. The atmosphere should feel ethereal, romantic, tranquil, and magical, with intricate decorative detail, luminous water reflections, and a polished vertical composition.

items.promptZh: 一幅特写动漫肖像，描绘的是一位神秘的年轻女子，有着长长的飘逸黑发，上面有生动的{argument name="accent color" default="violet"}条纹，从胸部向上显示，背景是干净的苍白背景。她的脸故意被一个大的中心方形检查块隐藏在柔和的灰色薰衣草色中，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和大部分嘴巴区域。一只耳朵完全可见，戴着 2 个耳环：一个几何形状的小耳钉和一个精致的长链耳环，末端饰有十字形饰物。她戴着两条项链：一条精美的银链和第二条镶有刻面钻石形紫色宝石的银吊坠项链。她的服装是一件超大宽松的露肩上衣，柔和的浅灰色，滑下来露出一侧肩膀，胸前印有一个黑色的小星星徽章。头发有光泽，层次分明，优雅地缠绕在构图上，紫色条纹形成鲜明的对比。在背景中添加细细的装饰性天体线条艺术，搭配 7 个可见的星星或闪光图案，搭配紫罗兰色和微妙的几何角框，营造出精致的哥特式、梦幻般的现代美感。柔和的灯光，精致的线条，柔和的中性调色板，强调黑色和紫色，高度抛光的动漫插图，居中构图，方形格式。
items.prompt: A close-up anime portrait of a mysterious young woman with very long flowing black hair threaded with vivid {argument name="accent color" default="violet"} streaks, shown from the chest up against a clean pale background. Her face is intentionally hidden by a large centered square censor block in muted gray-lavender, covering the eyes, nose, and most of the mouth area. One ear is fully visible with 2 earrings: a small geometric stud and a long delicate chain earring ending in a cross-like charm. She wears 2 necklaces: a fine silver chain and a second silver pendant necklace with a faceted diamond-shaped purple gemstone. Her outfit is an oversized loose off-shoulder top in soft light gray, slipping down to reveal one shoulder, with a small black star emblem printed on the chest. The hair is glossy, layered, and winds across the composition in elegant strands, with the purple streaks creating dramatic contrast. Add thin decorative celestial line art in the background with 7 visible star or sparkle motifs in matching violet and subtle geometric corner framing, giving a refined gothic, dreamy, modern aesthetic. Soft lighting, delicate linework, pastel-neutral palette with black and violet emphasis, highly polished anime illustration, centered composition, square format.

items.title: 阳光咖啡店少女插画
items.promptZh: 一幅梦幻般的绘画动漫风格全身插图，描绘了一位年轻女子站在阳光明媚的咖啡馆入口外，强烈关注她的脸部和目光的方向。她稍微转向图像的右侧，头侧向一侧，仿佛看着镜头外的街道。她的脸被柔和地简化，部分被明亮的光线遮住，五官精致，没有粗糙的轮廓。她有一头长长的棕色波浪发，带有温暖的金色亮点，松散的发丝捕捉着阳光，一侧有一个小发夹。她穿着一件宽松的米色长袖连身衣或短裙，腰部有褶皱，袖子柔软飘逸，白色皱褶袜子，厚底白色运动鞋，肩背一个带有金色细链带的白色小肩包。她拿着一杯透明塑料冰咖啡，双手握住一根黑色吸管，高度与胸部齐平。背景是一家舒适咖啡馆的外部，右侧有高高的玻璃门窗，还有 2 个可见的咖啡馆标志，上面写着“MOUNT TOKYO”，上面写着较小的文字“咖啡、三明治和更多……”——1 个壁挂式矩形标志和 1 个靠近左下角的黑色 A 形人行道标志； A 形框架还在底部附近包含了营业时间的小文字。包括 1 个沿左边缘的简单木凳。整个场景充满了斑驳的阳光和浓密的树叶阴影，投射在墙壁、玻璃、地面、长凳和女人的衣服上，营造出一种闪闪发光的夏日氛围。使用柔和的水彩画和水粉画般的渲染风格，带有明亮的过度曝光高光、温暖的奶油色、金色和桃色色调，与凉爽的蓝色阴影口音、纹理笔触、反光玻璃和怀旧的轻快情绪混合在一起。垂直构图，从头到鞋的全身可见，优雅的时尚插画框架，高度细致的环境，阳光照射的日本咖啡馆​​街景。
items.prompt: A dreamy painterly anime-style full-body illustration of a young woman standing just outside a sunlit cafe entrance, with strong attention to the direction of her face and gaze. She is turned slightly to the right side of the image, her head angled sideways as if looking off-camera toward the street. Her face is softly simplified and partially obscured by bright light, with delicate features and no harsh outlines. She has long wavy brown hair with warm golden highlights, loose strands catching the sunlight, and a small hair clip near one side. She wears a loose cream-beige long-sleeved romper or short dress with a gathered waist and soft flowing sleeves, white scrunched socks, chunky white sneakers, and a small white shoulder bag with a thin gold chain strap. She holds 1 clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a black straw in both hands at chest height. The setting is the exterior of a cozy cafe with tall glass doors and windows on the right, and 2 visible cafe signs that read “MOUNT TOKYO” with smaller text “COFFEE, SANDWICH and more...” — 1 wall-mounted rectangular sign and 1 black A-frame sidewalk sign near the lower left; the A-frame also includes small opening hours text near the bottom. Include 1 simple wooden bench along the left edge. The whole scene is filled with dappled sunlight and dense leaf shadows cast across the walls, glass, ground, bench, and the woman’s clothing, creating a shimmering summer atmosphere. Use a soft watercolor and gouache-like rendering style with luminous overexposed highlights, warm cream, gold, and peach tones mixed with cool blue shadow accents, textured brushwork, reflective glass, and a nostalgic airy mood. Vertical composition, full body visible from head to shoes, elegant fashion illustration framing, highly detailed environment, sun-washed cafe street scene in Japan.

items.title: 像素风乌鸦麦田
items.promptZh: 一幅风格化的人造像素艺术风景插图，其中一只{argument name="birdspecies"default="black raven"}站在金色麦田中，面向右侧。当缩小查看时，图像乍一看应该像复古像素艺术，但不是完美的网格对齐或真正的基于精灵的像素艺术；相反，它应该感觉像模仿像素艺术的绘画图像生成，块形状和边缘具有柔和的不一致。将大鸟放在前景中，中心稍偏左，有光泽的近黑色羽毛，深海军蓝和靛蓝阴影，黑色的喙，一只琥珀棕色的小眼睛可见。周围是高大的金黄色草丛，前景中散布着 9 朵可见的紫色小野花。中景显示一片广阔的乡村平原，田野零星分布，还有深绿色的林线，右侧还包括一些又高又窄的针叶树。远处，添加了柔和的蓝紫色色调的低矮山脉。在上面，创建一个明亮的{argument name="sky color" default="soft blue"}天空，其中充满了大块的积云和一些较小的云带，所有这些都以有限颜色的抖动块渲染。采用金色、蓝色、薰衣草色和深炭色的温暖午后调色板，大气深度强烈，有平静的田园情调。全画幅构图，横向，整个图像周围的细黑边框，清晰的块状边缘，复古的游戏背景美感，高度详细但简单，没有文字，没有 UI，没有多余的动物。
items.prompt: A stylized faux-pixel-art landscape illustration of a single {argument name="bird species" default="black raven"} standing in profile in a golden wheat field, facing right. The image should look like retro pixel art at first glance when viewed zoomed out, but not be perfectly grid-aligned or true sprite-based pixel art; instead it should feel like painterly image-generation imitating pixel art, with soft inconsistencies in the block shapes and edges. Place the bird large in the foreground, slightly left of center, with glossy near-black feathers shaded in deep navy and indigo, a dark beak, and one small amber-brown eye visible. Surround it with tall yellow-gold grasses and exactly 9 visible small purple wildflower blossoms scattered in the foreground. In the midground, show a broad rural plain with patchy fields and a dark green tree line including a few tall narrow conifers on the right. In the distance, add a low mountain range in muted blue-violet tones. Above, create a bright {argument name="sky color" default="soft blue"} sky filled with large chunky cumulus clouds and a few smaller cloud bands, all rendered in limited-color dithered blocks. Use a warm late-afternoon palette with gold, blue, lavender, and dark charcoal, strong atmospheric depth, and a calm pastoral mood. Full-frame composition, landscape orientation, thin black border around the entire image, crisp blocky edges, retro game background aesthetic, highly detailed but simple, no text, no UI, no extra animals.

items.title: 像素风局部对比图
items.promptZh: 紧密放大的比较图像展示了假像素艺术渲染，显示了屏幕上放大的低分辨率场景，整个框架上覆盖着薄薄的亮蓝色方形网格。该构图是像素艺术风格环境的抽象特写：左侧和中心为沙褐色和赭色块状形状，右侧为深海军蓝和黑色阶梯状对角线质量，沿上部背景的柔和橄榄绿和石板蓝色形状，以及一些浅金色亮点。乍一看，每条边缘都像楼梯一样且块状，但颜色在明显的正方形内柔和地模糊和混合，而不是与网格完美对齐，创造了在检查时崩溃的像素艺术的印象。在左上象限附近添加一个小的白色十字光标，以建议在编辑器中进行图像分析。整体外观应该像是来自图形程序或社交媒体演示的屏幕截图，展示人工智能如何模仿复古游戏艺术美学，而不产生真正的完美网格像素艺术，并且没有可见的文本标签。
items.prompt: A tightly zoomed-in comparison image demonstrating fake pixel-art rendering, showing a low-resolution-looking scene enlarged on screen with a thin bright blue square grid overlay across the entire frame. The composition is an abstract close crop of a pixel-art-style environment: sandy tan and ochre blocky forms on the left and center, a dark navy and black stepped diagonal mass on the right, muted olive-green and slate-blue shapes along the upper background, and a few lighter golden highlights. Every edge looks staircase-like and blocky at first glance, but the colors softly blur and blend within the apparent squares instead of aligning perfectly to the grid, creating the impression of pixel art that breaks down under inspection. Include a small white crosshair cursor near the upper left quadrant to suggest image analysis in an editor. The overall look should feel like a screenshot from a graphics program or social media demonstration about how AI can imitate retro game art aesthetics without producing true grid-perfect pixel art, with no text labels visible.

items.promptZh: 一幅柔和、柔和的动漫风格插图，描绘了一位年轻女子坐在室内的桌子旁，从稍微抬高的特写角度展示，就像在随意自拍一样。她的脸被一个温暖的灰褐色调的中心方形检查块完全遮挡。她有一头略显凌乱的{argument name="hair color" default="medium Brown"}长发，精致的发丝垂落在肩膀和胸前，自然光泽，剪裁柔和，层次分明。她穿着一件超大号的{argument name="top color" default="off-white"}运动衫，外搭灰色内领，外加一条带有小吊坠的细银项链。她的姿势轻松而亲密，一只手臂伸向观众，肩膀略微倾斜，身体斜跨在画面上。背景简约而平静：米色的墙壁、深色的长凳或椅背，以及右下角可见的木质桌面一角。在右下角靠近她膝盖的地方放一条棕褐色裙子或折叠的米色布料。使用柔和的大地色调、柔和的阴影、绘画般的线条、舒适的日常心情以及干净的当代日本插画美学。
items.prompt: A soft, muted anime-style illustration of a young woman seated indoors at a table, shown from a slightly elevated close-up angle as if taken in a casual selfie. Her face is fully obscured by a centered square censor block in a warm taupe tone. She has long, slightly tousled {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair with delicate strands falling over her shoulders and chest, natural shine, and a gentle layered cut. She wears an oversized {argument name="top color" default="off-white"} sweatshirt over a visible gray inner collar, plus a thin silver necklace with a small drop pendant. Her pose is relaxed and intimate, with one arm extending toward the viewer, shoulders slightly angled, and her body turned diagonally across the frame. The background is minimal and calm: a beige wall, a dark bench or chair back, and the corner of a wooden tabletop visible at the lower right. Include a tan skirt or folded beige fabric near her lap at the bottom right. Use subdued earth tones, soft shading, painterly linework, a cozy everyday mood, and a clean contemporary Japanese illustration aesthetic.

items.title: 企鹅道场拖鞋对决
items.prompt: 一幅极具动态感的动漫插画，描绘了一个{argument name="第一个角色" default="企鹅"}和另一个{argument name="第二个角色" default="企鹅"}在传统木质道场内进行激烈武术对决的场景。在前景中，一名 {argument name="角色一外貌" default="看图一"} 的企鹅摆出强有力的低位武术架势，手上拿着一个拖鞋准备反击，它身穿 {argument name="角色一着装" default="看图一"}，强烈的红色能量斩击环绕着它挥动的四肢。在右侧半空中，一名留着 {argument name="角色二外貌" default="看图二"} 的企鹅优雅地跃起，自信地，身穿 {argument name="角色二着装" default="看图二"}，伴随着扫过的蓝色水流状能量轨迹，手上也拿着一个拖鞋准备反击。背景是质朴的木质寺庙内部，上方悬挂着一块写有“{argument name="招牌文字" default="拖鞋比武大赛"}”的醒目招牌。场景充满了爆发性的动作感，飞扬的尘土、破碎的木质地板、发光的彩色粒子特效，以及将角色与精细背景完美区分开来的戏剧性低角度光影。保持它们脚形不变。\n\nMake the aspect ratio 16:9

items.promptZh: 用于游戏直播的充满活力的动漫风格 YouTube 缩略图，采用 16:9 宽幅构图，带有霓虹紫色和粉色流光室。场景以可爱的猫女 VTuber 为中心，她坐在办公桌前，腰部以上，身体前倾，一只手放在电脑鼠标上，另一只手伸向观众。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="light Orange-blonde"}短发，有着柔软的刘海、蓬松的棕色和奶油色猫耳朵，还有一条明显的猫尾巴。她的脸被中央的实心矩形检查块故意遮挡。她穿着黑白女仆风格的服装，包括褶边白色衬衫、黑色连衣裙紧身胸衣、泡泡袖、白色荷叶边、黑色丝带蝴蝶结和金色铃铛项圈。在桌子上放置一个带有明亮 RGB 灯光的机械键盘，一个发光的游戏鼠标，以及最左侧带有粉紫色 LED 灯光的流媒体麦克风。在前景中放置 2 个以猫为主题的桌面物品：左下角的毛绒猫脸和右下角的黑色猫形马克杯。她身后是一把带有爪子图案细节的游戏椅。在左侧，添加大的粗体韩文标题文本，采用粗白色大写字母，带有黑色填充阴影和发光的紫色轮廓，堆叠在 2 行中：{argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}。在其下方添加一个较小的黄色漫画风格连拍标题，其黑色轮廓为 {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}。在右侧，展示了一台向内倾斜的大型计算机显示器，显示了类似 Minecraft 的场景，其中有明亮的蓝天、绿树、水和一个巨大的绿色爬行动物向观看者弹出，其轮廓戏剧性地像贴纸剪纸一样。在显示器周围添加星爆效果和霓虹灯效果，以加剧混乱。使用夸张的缩略图美感：超饱和的颜色、锐利的卡通阴影、粗轮廓、光泽高光、高对比度、动态透视以及值得点击的流光灾难情绪。

She has {argument name="hair color" default="light orange-blonde"} bob-cut hair with soft bangs, fluffy brown-and-cream cat ears, and a visible cat tail. Her face is intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in the center. She wears a black-and-white maid-inspired outfit with a frilly white blouse, black dress bodice, puff sleeves, white ruffles, black ribbon bow, and a gold bell choker. Place a mechanical keyboard with bright RGB lighting on the desk, a glowing gaming mouse, and a streamer microphone on the far left with pink-purple LED lighting. Put 2 cat-themed desk items in the foreground: a plush cat face on the bottom left and a black cat-shaped mug on the bottom right. Behind her is a gaming chair with paw-print details. On the left side, add large bold Korean headline text in thick white block letters with black fill shadows and a glowing purple outline, stacked in 2 lines: {argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}. Below it, add a smaller yellow comic-style burst caption with black outline reading {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}. On the right side, show 1 large computer monitor angled inward, displaying a Minecraft-like scene with bright blue sky, green trees, water, and a large green Creeper popping out toward the viewer, outlined dramatically like a sticker cutout. Add starburst effects and neon accents around the monitor to heighten the chaos. Use exaggerated thumbnail aesthetics: ultra-saturated colors, sharp cel shading, thick outlines, glossy highlights, high contrast, dynamic perspective, and a clickworthy streamer-disaster mood.

items.promptZh: 一张密集的超现实拼贴海报，将复古日本街头文化、反乌托邦未来主义、环境崩溃和宇宙梦想意象融合在一个垂直堆叠的构图中。图像应该感觉像是由撕破的海报、墨水插图、漫画纹理、水彩水洗、报纸印刷、喷漆和平面设计片段制成的分层混合媒体街头艺术。整体色调结合了深夜蓝色、黑色、奶油纸色调、霓虹洋红色、深红色、樱花粉色和工业灰色。左上角，富士山背后有一轮巨大的红日，樱花树枝穿过拐角，天空中还有一架小飞机。沿着左侧和左下角，描绘了一条拥挤的类似东京的城市街道，挤满了行人、发光的标志、密集的建筑物，以及一座高大的圆柱形建筑，顶部附近有一张笑脸，还有一个垂直的标志，上面写着“AI正在看着你”。在附近的建筑物上添加风格化的日式标牌。添加一个巨大的波浪图案和一座融入城市场景的宝塔。在上部中心，放置一个黑暗的工业天际线，多个烟囱释放出巨大的黑云，转变为一个巨大的宇航员向前漂浮，一只手伸出。在右上角，将天空变成带有星星、旋转的紫蓝色星云和黑洞的外太空。在其之下，创建一个未来生态城市，其中有时尚的摩天大楼、茂密的树木、悬崖和瀑布。在最右侧添加一个发光的霓虹灯标志，上面写着“梦想是免费的”。在宇航员附近，放置一张撕破的海报，上面用大字体写着“未来未写”，在其下方用小字体写着“但我们是作者”。在整个中心，在部分模糊的中央人物肖像周围分层放置樱花和大玫瑰等花卉元素，给人一种支离破碎的身份感。在中下部，显示一个人从后面穿着深色连帽夹克，上面写着涂鸦风格的文字“质疑一切”。在它们周围，包括额外的剪纸肖像片段、蒙德里安风格的红、蓝、黄、白和黑色矩形几何块、古典大理石半身像片段、飞行中的白鸽、写着“平等≠平等”的小抗议标志，以及一个面向未来风景的坐着的人物。在左下角，包括一个戴着深色帽子和外套的黑色风格人物的一部分，在右下角，包括一个漫画风格女性脸部的侧面轮廓。到处都是散落的涂鸦、撕裂的边缘、墨水飞溅、分层的纸张纹理和海报残留物。构图应该非常忙碌、电影化、发人深省，以高细节当代拼贴壁画的风格平衡希望与焦虑、传统与技术、自然与城市超载。
items.prompt: A dense surreal collage poster blending retro Japanese street culture, dystopian futurism, environmental collapse, and cosmic dream imagery in one vertically stacked composition. The image should feel like layered mixed-media street art made from torn posters, ink illustration, manga textures, watercolor washes, newspaper print, spray paint, and graphic design fragments. The overall palette combines deep midnight blues, black, cream paper tones, neon magenta, crimson red, cherry blossom pink, and industrial gray. In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.

items.title: 彩虹发少女咖啡店插画
items.titleZh: 彩虹发少女咖啡店插画
items.prompt: A highly detailed, whimsical anime cafe illustration in a vertical composition, featuring a chibi girl mascot standing at the center of a cozy fantasy coffee shop during golden sunrise. She has extremely long, voluminous hair with a vivid rainbow gradient that begins as {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue at the crown"} and flows through cyan, green, yellow, orange, pink, and purple at the tips, with glossy highlights and thick bangs framing large sparkling blue eyes. She wears oversized silver headphones with green four-leaf clover emblems on both earcups, a red leather jacket, a white T-shirt with a yellow smiley face, fitted blue jeans, and white high-top sneakers with red accents. She smiles warmly and holds a white coffee mug decorated with a green clover symbol. Add a speech bubble near her head containing Japanese text: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="おはよう。今日も、ひとくち目の幸せから。"}. The cafe interior is richly decorated with dark polished wood, hanging banners, shelves filled with glass bottles and jars, trailing green plants, glowing crystal ornaments, and warm amber lighting. On the left upper area, hang a blackboard menu sign labeled {argument name="cafe name" default="AriteAL Cafe Menu"} with Japanese handwritten menu items and small coffee doodles. In the right background, place tall arched windows showing a dreamy pastel sunrise sky and storybook castle-like towers outside. Include exactly 2 mascot creatures: 1 small blue penguin barista on the left beside stacked clover mugs, and 1 small black cat-like creature with tiny bat wings and a red bow tie near a chalkboard sign on the lower right. In the foreground on a round table, show exactly 4 featured food and drink items: 1 thick slice of toast topped with a green clover garnish, 1 cup of latte art coffee in a clover cup, 1 glass jar of honey, and 1 tall rainbow parfait layered with colorful jelly, whipped cream, berries, strawberry slices, and crystal-like candy shards. Also place a teapot and additional clover-pattern cups on side tables in the midground. Add a small standing chalkboard sign on the lower right with Japanese welcome text and the cafe name. The whole image should feel magical, cheerful, polished, and richly rendered, with soft sparkles, warm morning light, saturated colors, intricate decorative details, and premium gpt-image-2 anime illustration quality.

items.title: 赛博朋克机械爪少女
items.promptZh: 一幅黑暗的赛博朋克动画插图，一个孤独的年轻女子，带着巨大的机械爪臂，站在夜晚雨天霓虹灯笼罩的小巷里，从一个戏剧性的低角度观看，让她看起来雄伟而危险。她脸色苍白，黑色的长发遮住了眼睛，一双红眸隐隐泛着红光，表情冰冷，没有任何感情。她穿着一件超大连帽冬季科技外套，配有大毛皮镶边兜帽和毛皮袖口，分层黑色战术街头服饰，配有肩带、腰带，宽松的深色裤子塞进厚重的靴子里。她的左臂被一个巨大的工业机械假肢所取代，该假肢占据了前景，里面装有密集的齿轮、活塞、管道、电缆、裸露的机械装置和发光的红色指示灯，末端是 3 个长而弯曲的爪子，爪子锋利的尖端从内部被深红色的能量照亮。在外套和机器上添加小贴花、警告标签和垂直东亚标牌。将她置于一条狭窄的未来城市街道上，街道上遍布高耸的建筑物、悬挂的电缆、薄雾和许多垂直的霓虹灯标志，上面写着红色和青绿色的汉字。路面湿漉漉的，像镜子一样，反射着爪子和周围标牌发出的红光。使用炭黑色、青铜色、深红色和病态青色等坚韧、超细节、高对比度的调色板。情绪冷漠、喜怒无常、令人生畏、聪明、略带忧郁。高度细致的线条、复杂的机械渲染、电影灯光、雨雾、城市密度、动漫遇上硬表面概念艺术、杰作品质。
items.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a lone young woman with a massive mechanical claw arm standing in a rainy neon-drenched alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her look imposing and dangerous. She has a pale face, long straight black hair partly hiding her eyes, and faintly glowing red eyes with a cold, emotionless expression. She wears an oversized hooded winter-tech coat with a large fur-trimmed hood and fur cuffs, layered black tactical streetwear, straps, belts, and baggy dark pants tucked into heavy boots. Her left arm is replaced by an enormous industrial mech prosthetic that dominates the foreground, packed with dense gears, pistons, tubing, cables, exposed mechanisms, and glowing red indicator lights, ending in 3 long curved talons with razor-sharp tips lit from within by crimson energy. Add small decals, warning labels, and vertical East Asian signage on the coat and machinery. Set her in a narrow futuristic city street filled with towering buildings, hanging cables, mist, and many vertical neon signs with Chinese characters in red and cyan-green. The pavement is wet and mirror-like, reflecting the red lights from the claw and the surrounding signage. Use a gritty, ultra-detailed, high-contrast palette of charcoal black, gunmetal, deep crimson, and sickly teal. The mood is cold, moody, intimidating, intelligent, and slightly melancholic. Highly detailed linework, complex mechanical rendering, cinematic lighting, rain haze, urban density, anime-meets-hard-surface concept art, masterpiece quality.

items.title: 未来感虚拟偶像肖像
items.promptZh: 简单的动漫风格上半身人物插图，位于纯浅灰色背景上，居中且面向左，摆出平静的四分之三姿势。该角色是一位年轻的未来派女性机器人或虚拟偶像，有着{argument name="hair color" default="platinum silver"}头发，左侧扎着一个粗辫子的发髻，长长的松散的侧发，光滑的直发流过肩膀。她的左耳戴着一个几何科幻耳机，带有发光的青色矩形面板和棱角分明的金属框架。她的服装是一件时尚的白色连体衣，配有黑色结构肩带和装饰，高高的黑色高领，以及细细的发光青色强调线垂直和对角地穿过胸部和躯干。她的白色臂袖上有黑色带子，上臂上有一个黑色的小菱形装饰。将图像渲染为干净、简约的草图插图，具有精致的铅笔般的线条、浅色卡通阴影、柔和的色彩、微妙的青色高光和抛光的概念艺术感觉。保持构图从头顶到胸部以下的裁剪，有大量的负空间，没有道具，没有文字，也没有详细的背景。
items.prompt: A simple anime-style upper-body character illustration on a plain light gray background, centered and facing slightly left in a calm three-quarter pose. The character is a young futuristic female android or virtual idol with {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair, styled with one thick braided bun over the left side of the head, long loose side strands, and smooth straight hair flowing past the shoulders. She wears a geometric sci-fi headset over the left ear with a glowing cyan rectangular panel and angular metallic frame. Her outfit is a sleek white bodysuit with black structural straps and trim, a tall black high-neck collar, and thin glowing cyan accent lines running vertically and diagonally across the chest and torso. She has detached white arm sleeves with black bands, including one small dark diamond-shaped ornament on the upper arm. Render the image as a clean, minimal sketchy illustration with delicate pencil-like linework, light cel shading, soft pastel colors, subtle cyan highlights, and a polished concept-art feel. Keep the composition cropped from the top of the head to below the chest, with lots of negative space and no props, no text, and no detailed background.

items.title: 未来风白发少女肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅简单的动漫风格的未来派年轻女性上半身肖像，以纯浅灰色背景为中心，以宽松的粗略线条和柔和的色彩绘制。她有一头飘逸的淡粉色紫丁香色的长发，垂过肩头，细细的发丝，看起来温柔有光泽。她的脸完全被柔和的灰色薰衣草色的大中心方形模糊/马赛克块隐藏。她戴着一顶类似贝雷帽的大白色帽子，带有深海军蓝内带和 2 个有棱角的深海军蓝侧面附件，每侧一个，并饰有小青色细节。在她头部可见的一侧添加一个带有半透明青色发光元素的时尚科幻耳机。她的服装是一件合身的无袖白色高领连体衣，正面有 2 块亮青色垂直镶片，黑色细缝线，胸部和腰部附近有小棱角的深海军盔甲状装饰。一只上臂有一条深色臂章，臂章上有 4 条青白色细条纹。展示她从胸部到头顶的位置，稍微面向观看者的左侧，轮廓干净优雅。使用极简的插画风格，细腻的手绘笔触，微妙的卡通阴影，白色、青色、海军蓝和淡粉色作为主要调色板，没有背景物体或文字。
items.prompt: A simple anime-style upper-body portrait of a futuristic young woman centered on a plain light gray background, drawn with loose sketchy linework and soft pastel coloring. She has long, flowing very pale pink-lilac hair that falls past her shoulders, with thin wispy strands and a gentle glossy look. Her face is completely hidden by a large centered square blur/mosaic block in muted gray-lavender. She wears a large white beret-like cap with a dark navy inner band and 2 angular dark navy side attachments, one on each side, accented with small cyan details. Add a sleek sci-fi earpiece on the visible side of her head with translucent cyan glowing elements. Her outfit is a fitted sleeveless white high-neck bodysuit with 2 bright cyan vertical panels on the front, thin dark seam lines, and small angular dark navy armor-like accents near the chest and waist. One upper arm has a dark armband with 4 thin cyan-white stripes. Show her from about the chest to the top of the head, facing slightly to the viewer’s left, with a clean elegant silhouette. Use a minimalist illustration style, delicate hand-drawn strokes, subtle cel-shading, white, cyan, navy, and pale pink as the main palette, and no background objects or text.

items.title: 花田少女仰视插画
items.prompt: A dreamy anime-style low-angle illustration of a young schoolgirl standing in a flower field under a vivid clear blue sky, viewed from near ground level as if the camera is among the blossoms looking up at her. She has a short platinum-blonde bob with soft bangs, bright blue eyes, pale skin, and a calm slightly serious expression. She wears a round yellow sunhat with a blue ribbon tied at the back, an oversized light blue smock-like dress with a white collar, a visible name tag pinned to her chest reading {argument name="name tag text" default="兀華"}, and a mustard-yellow crossbody satchel. One hand is extended toward the viewer with the palm open, creating strong foreground foreshortening. Surround her with exactly 6 prominent flowers in the composition: 2 large white cosmos flowers in the left foreground, 1 large blue flower in the right foreground, 1 white flower in the upper right background, and 2 smaller blue blossoms near the bottom center. Use soft painterly watercolor textures, delicate linework, airy lighting, gentle depth of field, and a luminous pastel palette dominated by sky blue, white, and yellow. The mood should feel innocent, nostalgic, fresh, and slightly magical, like a children’s book illustration mixed with high-end anime key art.

items.title: 日系时尚杂志封面
items.prompt: A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover illustration in elegant contemporary editorial style, vertical full-page composition. The cover title is a huge teal serif masthead reading "AURA" across the top. In the upper right, include 4 stacked issue details: "6", "June 2025", "No.126", and a small boxed label "アウラ", followed by the price line "特別定価 ¥980". The background is a bright pale blue sky with soft white clouds. Center the portrait of an androgynous, ethereal young model, shown from chest up, wearing a crisp white tailored jacket with subtle gold piping, a white shirt, a vivid aqua-teal vest or tie layer, and a gemstone-like star brooch at the collar. The character has very long, layered, windswept hair in {argument name="hair color" default="icy white with pale aqua tint"}, with glossy strands flowing across the shoulders, and fair luminous skin. The face is largely obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in muted gray-blue to pale pink gradient, covering the eyes, nose, and upper cheeks; the visible lower face shows a soft mouth and refined chin. One hand is raised near the lips in a thoughtful fashion-portrait pose. Use delicate anime-inspired linework, airy lighting, translucent highlights, and luxury beauty-editorial rendering. Add 3 left-column cover blurbs in Japanese with teal headlines and smaller black body text: first, "透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア" with 2 smaller lines beneath; second, "好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術" with 2 smaller lines beneath; third, "プロが教える 美しい髪の条件" with 2 smaller lines beneath. Add a teal circular badge on the right with 4 lines of white text: "Special Interview", "風と光と、", "自分らしさと。", and "ソラが語る 日常と美学". Near the lower center, place a small italic English line "Cover & Special Feature" above the large Japanese main headline "ソラ、という名の透明感。" with the first word in teal and the rest in black. Under that, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese subheadline text. Along the bottom edge, create 3 feature teasers with pale italic English category labels and Japanese copy beneath: left label "Fashion", center label "Beauty", right label "Trend", each with 2 short Japanese lines. Overall mood: serene, luxurious, airy, refreshing early-summer beauty fashion cover with cohesive aqua-and-white color design.

items.title: 海边石阶少女与信卡
items.prompt: A luminous anime-style illustration of a young woman standing on a sunlit stone stairway in a Mediterranean seaside town, with the viewpoint at half-body to three-quarter-body height. She has very long, flowing dark brown hair with soft highlights, slightly windswept, styled with small white flower hairpins near one side of her head. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and angle, creating a gentle, dreamy, anonymous mood. She wears a delicate sleeveless {argument name="dress color" default="pale lavender-white"} summer dress with thin straps, lace trim, a soft fitted waist, and a large ribbon bow tied at the back. The background shows 1 narrow stone stair street lined with old buildings and greenery, 1 bright blue sea bay, 1 distant coastline with mountains, 1 lighthouse-like tower, and several tiny white boats on the water under a clear sky with soft clouds. Warm midday sunlight, sparkling atmosphere, romantic vacation postcard feeling, highly detailed anime painting, soft painterly textures, vivid blue ocean, lush green foliage, elegant feminine character design. On the right side, place 1 large white paper letter card floating as a clean overlay, with neat handwritten-style Japanese text in dark ink, including friendly emojis and flowers, as if it is a heartfelt fan message or thank-you note. The note should read: 「いつも見守ってくださって ありがとうございます😊✨ 皆さんの優しい言葉や応援が、紬の心の支えになっています🌷 日々の小さな幸せを大切にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を届けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、皆さんの心が 穏やかであたたかい毎日で ありますように…🍀💖 結葉紬より🌸」. Make the letter large, legible, and balanced against the character, with a clean white background and slight paper texture. Add small subtle credit text in the bottom-left corner reading {argument name="credit text" default="Co-Creation with Motohiko Sato & AI"}.

items.title: 月球基地校服少女
items.promptZh: 一幅非常详细的动画插图，一个美丽的少女女学生坐在布满星星的太空天空下的岩石月球表面上，右上方的背景是一个巨大的发光的蓝色地球。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="silver White"}头发，非常长，在低重力的微风中飘逸，两个圆形的双发髻高高地盘在头的两侧，长长的松散的发丝层叠在她的身体周围。她的脸被头部上方的扁平方形检查块遮挡，看不到任何面部特征。她穿着日式校服：清爽的白色长袖衬衫，深海军蓝无袖毛衣背心，领口有水鸭绿丝带蝴蝶结，深色百褶短裙，白色及膝袜，棕色皮乐福鞋。她侧身坐在一块岩石上，双腿向观众伸展，一只手放在身后的石头上作为支撑，形成了一个略低角度的构图，强调了她的腿和头发。场景被戏剧性的冷月光和来自太空的边缘照明照亮，在她的头发、衣服褶皱和布满灰尘的月球岩石上产生了光泽的亮点。在遥远的右中背景中，恰好包括 3 个可见的月球基地结构：一个高天线塔、1 个碟状通信单元和 1 个圆柱形装置。在左下前景中，包括部分进入框架的弯曲金属航天器或栖息地边缘。超细致的纹理、闪闪发光的灰尘颗粒、锐利的线条、柔和的大气辉光和优质的抛光动漫关键视觉质量，让环境感觉像电影、宁静、未来感和略带忧郁。
items.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration of a beautiful teenage schoolgirl sitting on a rocky lunar surface under a deep star-filled space sky, with a large glowing blue Earth dominating the upper right background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair, extremely long and flowing in the low-gravity breeze, styled with two rounded twin buns high on the sides of her head and long loose strands cascading around her body. Her face is obscured by a flat square censor block centered over the head, with no facial features visible. She wears a Japanese-style school uniform: a crisp white long-sleeve blouse, a dark navy sleeveless sweater vest, a teal-green ribbon bow at the collar, a short dark pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown leather loafers. She is posed seated sideways on a rock with both legs extended toward the viewer, one hand resting behind her on the stone for support, creating a slightly low-angle composition that emphasizes her legs and hair. The scene is lit with dramatic cool moonlight and rim lighting from space, producing glossy highlights on her hair, clothing folds, and the dusty lunar rocks. In the distant mid-right background, include exactly 3 visible lunar base structures: a tall antenna tower, 1 dish-like communication unit, and 1 cylindrical installation. In the lower left foreground, include a curved metallic spacecraft or habitat rim partially entering the frame. Make the environment feel cinematic, serene, futuristic, and slightly melancholic, with ultra-detailed textures, sparkling dust particles, sharp linework, soft atmospheric glow, and premium polished anime key visual quality.

items.promptZh: 一幅高度详细的动画插图，从略高的四分之三角度观看，一名十几岁的女学生坐在外太空的岩石月球表面上。她有一头飘逸的长发，顶部有两个圆圆的奥丹戈发髻，松散的发丝急剧地向右流动，就像在低重力或太阳风中一样。她的脸被一个朴素的矩形检查块遮挡，颜色为柔和的米灰色，位于整个脸部的中央。她穿着日式校服：白色长袖上衣，深藏青色无袖毛衣背心，领口系着绿色丝带小蝴蝶结，灰色百褶裙，白色及膝袜，棕色乐福鞋。她坐在月球岩石的边缘，一只手撑在身后，另一只手放在身体两侧，双腿向前倾斜，摆出放松的姿势。背景是深邃的繁星密布的黑色天空，地球在右上角发光，显示出亚太地区，柔和的阳光从右上角斜射进来。月球地形呈亮灰色，布满陨石坑和锯齿状岩石。恰好包括 3 件月球设备：前景和中景左侧的 2 个金属盒状面板或仪器箱，以及右下角的 1 个小型漫游车或类似天线的设备。灯光如电影般凉爽，头发上有明亮的边缘光，制服和腿部有柔和的亮点。以精美的现代动漫关键视觉风格、超干净的线条、发光的发丝、微妙的深度和渴望的科幻情绪进行渲染。
items.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration of a teenage schoolgirl sitting on a rocky lunar surface in outer space, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with two round odango buns on top and loose strands streaming dramatically to the right as if in low gravity or solar wind. Her face is obscured by a plain rectangular censor block in a muted beige-gray color, centered over the entire face. She wears a Japanese-style school uniform: a white long-sleeve blouse, a dark navy sleeveless sweater vest, a small green ribbon bow at the collar, a gray pleated skirt, white knee socks, and brown loafers. She is seated on the edge of a moon rock with one hand braced behind her and the other resting near her side, legs angled forward in a relaxed pose. The background is a deep star-filled black sky with the planet Earth glowing in the upper right, showing the Asia-Pacific region, with a soft sunbeam entering diagonally from the top right. The moon terrain is bright gray and heavily textured with craters and jagged rocks. Include exactly 3 pieces of lunar equipment: 2 metallic boxy panels or instrument cases on the left side of the foreground and midground, and 1 small rover or antenna-like device on the lower right. Lighting is cinematic and cool, with bright rim light on the hair and soft highlights on the uniform and legs. Render in polished modern anime key visual style, ultra-clean linework, luminous hair strands, subtle depth, and a wistful sci-fi mood.

items.prompt: A polished anime illustration of a slender teenage schoolgirl with {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair, floating weightlessly above the Moon’s surface in a calm seated pose. She has extremely long flowing hair that streams dramatically to the right, with two round twin buns on top of her head and long loose strands cascading past her legs. She wears a Japanese-style school uniform: a white button-up blouse, a dark navy sweater vest, a green ribbon bow at the collar, a charcoal pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown loafers. The lunar ground below is pale gray, dusty, and cratered, with scattered rocks, soft shadows, and a few small futuristic moon-base domes and antenna-like structures along the distant horizon. Use cool moonlight with subtle rim lighting around the hair and body, high detail in the hair strands and fabric folds, soft luminous anime shading, crisp linework, and a dreamy sci-fi atmosphere combining cute schoolgirl character art with realistic space scenery.

items.promptZh:
一幅黑暗的、电影般的动漫群像，灵感来自《最后的晚餐》，背景设定在夜晚的长石宴会厅中。准确地展示了 11 个坐着或倾斜的女性角色，肩并肩地排列在铺着白色桌布的长桌后面，以宽大的对称构图直接观看。正中央是一位身穿华丽的蓝银盔甲和宝蓝色连衣裙的金发骑士女子，双臂铠甲沿着桌子延伸，成为视觉焦点。她面前放着一个发光的金色圣杯，将温暖的光芒向上照射到人们的脸上和手上。在他们身后，三扇高大的拱形窗户展现出暮色中的风景，一棵巨大的树在昏暗的天空下映出轮廓。天花板有深色木梁，侧壁上排列着大型阴影框画。

这 11 个角色应该感觉像是标志性动漫风格女性的跨界组合，具有不同的轮廓、发型和时尚。从左到右：1）一位身穿光亮红色紧身未来派套装的女士，身体前倾，一只手放在桌子上； 2）她身边有一位身穿柔和军装的黑发女子； 3）苍白的哥特式女孩，穿着长袖黑色连衣裙，纤细的手指举起双手； 4）金发短发女人，穿着宽松的白色T恤，休闲又摩登； 5) 一位身穿白衬衫、身材高大、红发的女士，稍稍落后于其他人； 6）中央的金发蓝色铠甲骑士； 7）一位身穿黑色连衣裙、戴着金色配饰和头饰的黑发女子，举起一根手指； 8）身着红色绣花长裙、留着黑色长发的迷人女子； 9) 一位身穿低胸黑色服装、身体向内倾斜的黑发女子； 10）一个穿着无袖服装的青色双马尾虚拟偶像女孩； 11) 最右边盘腿坐着一个穿着浅色图案连衣裙的绿发女孩，手里拿着一个酒杯。保持所有面孔有吸引力的动漫面孔，成熟的年轻成年女性，优雅而不是漫画。

桌子上正好有 11 个餐具、8 个可见的红酒杯、几条面包和散落的面包卷、盘子、银器、面包屑和一些金属高脚杯或杯子。温暖的圣杯灯应该照亮中心，而房间的其余部分则陷入喜怒无常的阴影中。采用绘画写实主义，高细节的动漫插画，戏剧性的明暗对比，柔和的棕色和蓝色氛围加上红色的点缀，庄重而略显颓废的气氛，超宽的全景取景，杰作品质。
items.prompt:
A dark, cinematic anime group portrait inspired by The Last Supper, set in a long stone banquet hall at night. Show exactly 11 seated or leaning female characters arranged shoulder to shoulder behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth, viewed straight on in a wide symmetrical composition. In the exact center is a blonde knightly woman in ornate blue-and-silver armor and a royal-blue dress, posed as the visual focal point with both armored arms extended along the table. In front of her sits a glowing golden chalice radiating warm light upward onto the faces and hands of the group. Behind them, three tall arched windows reveal a twilight landscape with a huge tree silhouetted against a dusky sky. The ceiling has dark wooden beams, and the side walls are lined with large shadowy framed paintings.

The 11 characters should feel like a crossover ensemble of iconic anime-style women with varied silhouettes, hairstyles, and fashion. From left to right: 1) a woman in a glossy red skintight futuristic suit, leaning forward with one hand on the table; 2) a dark-haired woman in muted military-style clothing close beside her; 3) a pale gothic girl in a black dress with long sleeves, hands lifted with delicate fingers; 4) a short blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) a tall red-haired woman in a white shirt standing slightly behind the others; 6) the central blonde armored knight in blue; 7) a black-haired woman in a black dress with gold accessories and a headpiece, raising one finger; 8) a glamorous woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) a dark-haired woman in a low-cut black outfit leaning inward; 10) a teal twin-tailed virtual-idol-like girl in a sleeveless outfit; 11) a green-haired girl in a pale patterned dress seated with crossed legs at the far right, holding a wine glass. Keep all faces attractive anime faces, mature young-adult women, elegant rather than caricatured.

On the table, include exactly 11 place settings, 8 visible wine glasses with red wine, several loaves of bread and scattered rolls, plates, silverware, crumbs, and a few metallic goblets or cups. The warm chalice light should illuminate the center while the rest of the room falls into moody shadow. Use painterly realism, high-detail anime illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, subdued brown and blue ambience with red accents, solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere, ultra-wide panoramic framing, masterpiece quality.

items.prompt: A soft, airy anime portrait of a delicate young woman in a minimalist off-white background, shown from the chest up in a close three-quarter view. She has long, slightly wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with ash-gray highlights"} hair with wispy strands and straight-cut bangs, tied on one side with a large black ribbon bow. Her eyes are large, glossy, and pale gray with detailed lashes and a dreamy, distant expression. She rests her cheek against one hand, with slender fingers partly covering her face and muted gray nail polish visible. She wears a white off-shoulder blouse with voluminous sleeves, soft ruffles, gathered fabric, and thin black ribbon ties on the sleeves, creating a gentle monochrome contrast. Add a single long, elegant gold drop earring with a small pearl on the visible ear. Use a clean manga-inspired illustration style with light linework, subtle blush tones, soft cel shading, and painterly highlights in the hair. The mood is quiet, wistful, and feminine, with a refined fashion-illustration feel and a very limited palette of white, black, taupe, and gray.

items.prompt: A luminous anime-style close-up portrait of a teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors in the rain, framed from the chest up, holding a transparent vinyl umbrella. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"} hair tied in a low side ponytail with soft loose strands and straight bangs, delicate round glasses, large glossy violet-blue eyes, and a calm, slightly awed expression as she looks upward toward leaves and raindrops. She wears a wet white short-sleeved school blouse and a dark blue plaid ribbon bow at the collar. The scene is filled with convincing water and light: rain falling in fine streaks, droplets clinging to the umbrella ribs, beads of water on her hair and shirt, and large crystal-clear drops hanging from broad green leaves in the upper right foreground. In the lower right and foreground, include blooming white garden flowers with dark glossy foliage covered in rain. Use a cool blue and silver palette with soft lavender highlights, backlit by diffused daylight after or during a shower, creating intense transparency, reflections, refraction, sparkling bokeh, and shimmering wet surfaces. The background should be an out-of-focus urban garden or residential walkway with fences and buildings blurred by rain, while the girl remains sharply rendered. Emphasize cinematic composition, layered foreground leaves, hyper-detailed raindrops, realistic translucent umbrella material, subtle rim light on wet hair, and an overall mood of quiet wonder and serene summer rain.

items.prompt:
16:9の劇場版アニメ映画ポスター。夜の森の境界領域。前景中央やや左に、10代後半の日本人少女。黒髪ポニーテール、細身、ダークカラーの実用的な防寒アウトドアジャケット、調査用バックパック。背中側を見せた3/4後ろ姿で肩越しに振り向く。落ち着いた緊張感と強い意志。
右上空の森の上に、白青色に発光する巨大な球状超常現象。無数の発光フィラメントと電気的な輪郭線が絡み合うエネルギー球。内部は霧がかった白光、周囲に微細な青白い粒子光。左奥には噴煙を上げる富士山。中景には日本語警告入りの立入禁止テープ、現実的な災害対応スタッフ、左右に救急車両。軍事感は不要。
地面はぬかるんだ山林で、浅い水流と濡れた地表が発光を反射。左右の高い木々が画面を囲む。空は満天の星、富士山麓には微細な街明かり。神秘と災厄が同時に存在する空気感。
少女、巨大光球、富士山の三角構図。やや低めのシネマティック視点。少女と光球を二大主役として大きく明確に見せる。冷たい夜の青を基調に、主光源は巨大光球の白青発光。木々、地面、水面、少女に強いリムライト。副光源として星明かりと遠方の噴火の微かな橙光。少女の顔は暗すぎず表情が読める。高コントラスト。
最新の日本劇場版アニメの高級感あるキービジュアル。映画ポスター級の完成度。高密度で繊細な背景、精密な光表現、空気遠近感、写実寄りで美しく整理されたアニメ作画。全体トーンはダークネイビー、白青発光、微かな火山の橙。荘厳、不穏、神秘的、ドラマ性が高い。
上部中央に小さめの日本語コピー: "{argument name="ポスターのキャッチコピー" default="それは奇跡ではない。彼岸の彼方へつながる災害だった。"}"
下部中央に大きく、白に近い淡い発光の上品な英字セリフ体タイトル: "{argument name="映画のタイトル" default="Re:Connect Worlds"}"
その直下に小さめの日本語サブタイトル: "{argument name="サブタイトル" default="境界の森"}"
文字は正確で高可読。指定以外の文字、ロゴ、透かしは入れない。余計な人物、モンスター、メカ、不要な派手な粒子やノイズは入れない。

items.title: 忧郁少女眼饰插画
items.promptZh: 一幅干净、极简主义的动画插图，描绘了一位忧郁的年轻女子的四分之三侧面，坐着并将脸颊靠在一只手上。她有一头长直的{argument name="hair color" default="blue-black"}头发，刘海平淡，皮肤非常苍白，柔和的灰蓝色眼睛带着疏远、疲倦的表情。她的脸小而精致，一只眼睛下面有一个微小的美人痣，睫毛也很微妙。她穿着深海军蓝和木炭色的深色超大分层服装：高领黑色上衣搭配宽松的垂褶夹克或和服式的外层，面料上饰有淡淡的金色线条和小眼睛图案。她的配饰灵感来自神秘主义且优雅：多个耳洞、一只长长的垂坠耳环，形状像一只眼睛，带有泪滴吊坠，一条带有小眼睛吊饰的细项链，还有几枚戒指，包括触摸她脸的手上的眼环。她的指甲涂成柔和的石板蓝色。背景是平坦的暖灰白色，上面有精心布置的神秘眼睛符号和悬挂装饰品的画廊。包含 6 个以眼睛为主题的墙壁元素：左上角有 1 个框架眼睛图片，其下方悬挂着 1 个圆形眼睛装饰品，右上角附近有 1 个小圆形目标状装饰品，最右侧有 1 个带有眼睛和几何水晶的黑色吊饰，中右有 1 个带有发光眼睛的方形面板，右下角有 1 个带有眼睛和 4 个泪珠形状的深色矩形面板。在左侧添加深色瓶子轮廓和一些柔和的蓝灰色叶子作为辅助装饰。使用海军蓝、黑色、奶油色、灰蓝色和柔和的金色等内敛的调色板。构图应该给人安静、哥特式、女性化和内省的感觉，具有平坦的图形形状、清晰的线条、很少的阴影和现代装饰海报美学。
items.prompt: A clean, minimalist anime illustration of a melancholic young woman in three-quarter profile, seated and resting her cheek against one hand. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="blue-black"} hair with blunt bangs, very pale skin, and soft gray-blue eyes with a distant, tired expression. Her face is small and delicate, with a tiny beauty mark under one eye and subtle lashes. She wears a dark oversized layered outfit in deep navy and charcoal: a high-neck black top under a loose draped jacket or kimono-like outer layer, with faint gold line accents and tiny eye motifs worked into the fabric. Her accessories are occult-inspired and elegant: multiple ear piercings, one long dangling earring shaped like an eye with a teardrop pendant, a thin necklace with a small eye charm, and several rings including an eye ring on the hand touching her face. Her nails are painted muted slate blue. The background is a flat warm off-white with a carefully arranged gallery of mystical eye symbols and hanging ornaments. Include exactly 6 eye-themed wall elements: 1 framed eye picture in the upper left, 1 circular eye ornament hanging below it, 1 small circle target-like ornament near the upper right, 1 black hanging charm with an eye and geometric crystals on the far right, 1 square panel with a radiant eye at mid-right, and 1 dark rectangular panel with an eye and 4 teardrop shapes at the lower right. Add a dark bottle silhouette and a few muted blue-gray leaves on the left side as secondary decor. Use a restrained palette of navy, black, cream, gray-blue, and touches of muted gold. The composition should feel quiet, gothic, feminine, and introspective, with flat graphic shapes, crisp linework, little shading, and a modern decorative poster aesthetic.

items.prompt: Create a high-impact vertical mobile game advertisement poster in glossy anime action style, with a dramatic cyber-samurai fantasy aesthetic and dense, premium gacha-RPG promotional composition. The main scene shows 2 young adult male fighters in modern black business suits crouching aggressively in the foreground, each drawing a katana toward the viewer. Both have styled blond hair, sharp handsome features, white dress shirts, blue neckties, and intense action poses, with foreshortened hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. One sword has a blue ribbon tied near the hilt. Behind them, centered and towering, place 1 massive armored mecha samurai with ornate gold horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, framed like a guardian deity. Use a vivid neon city and energy-burst backdrop in electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold, with light streaks, sparks, petals, slash effects, and ink-brush explosion textures. Add 1 vertical black brushstroke banner on the upper right with bold white Japanese text reading 「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」. Across the middle-lower area, place 1 huge gold Japanese calligraphy headline with thick brush texture and black shadow reading 「切り捨て御免」, spanning nearly the full width. In the lower left, embed 1 framed gameplay screenshot panel with a gold border, showing a night battle in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard, 1 playable swordsman in combat, multiple enemies, floating damage numbers including 5324, 5329, and 6132, a left-side virtual joystick, 5 character portraits total arranged vertically and along the bottom, 3 circular skill buttons on the right, and a top HUD showing a timer around 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the lower right, place 1 large black-and-white QR code inside a white square frame. Beneath and beside it, add bold Japanese text in white with blue outline reading 「今すぐダウンロード」. At the very bottom, include 2 official-style store badges: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall look: ultra-detailed, polished key art, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel-shaded anime rendering, premium mobile game marketing poster, intense action energy, cinematic lighting, and layered UI-heavy promotional layout.

items.promptZh: 动态动画风格的插图，描绘了一个衣着光鲜的年轻人，摆出戏剧性的缩短动作姿势，从上方观看，仿佛他正在向上冲向镜头，同时向观众笔直拉出一把剑。他有一头{argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"}头发，造型整齐，中间部分柔软后掠，皮肤白皙。他的脸大部分被镜头角度和阴影遮住，营造出一种神秘、时尚的外观。他穿着一套剪裁精良、光泽微妙的深海军蓝西装、一件浅蓝色正装衬衫、一条鲜艳的蓝色领带和一双抛光的黑色正装鞋。一只手在极端的视角中占据着前景，握着华丽的剑柄；另一只手则握着华丽的剑柄。另一只手将刀片拉出，强调运动和张力。这把剑有 1 个细长的银色刀片、1 个带有互锁环的精致金属护手和 1 个雕刻鞍头。构图大胆而生动，人物对角线穿过 1 个大型倒三角形背景，背景上充满浅水绿色和绿松石色的几何扇形图案，以细薄的温暖米色边框勾勒出轮廓，衬托在干净的浅灰色背景上。高细节的数字绘画，光泽的动漫插图，优雅的动作角色艺术，清晰的线条，丰富的织物褶皱，戏剧性的透视变形，时尚杂志的润色，凉爽的蓝色调色板，白色的负空间，居中的垂直构图。
items.prompt: A dynamic anime-style illustration of a sharply dressed young man in a dramatic foreshortened action pose, viewed from above as if he is lunging upward toward the camera while drawing a rapier straight at the viewer. He has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, neatly styled with a center part and soft swept-back volume, and fair skin. His face is mostly hidden by the camera angle and shadow, creating a mysterious, stylish look. He wears a tailored dark navy business suit with a subtle sheen, a light blue dress shirt, a vivid blue necktie, and polished black dress shoes. One hand dominates the foreground in extreme perspective, gripping the ornate rapier hilt; the other hand pulls the blade free, emphasizing motion and tension. The sword has 1 slender silver blade, 1 elaborate metallic guard with interlocking loops, and 1 engraved pommel. The composition is bold and graphic, with the character diagonally crossing the frame over 1 large inverted triangle backdrop filled with pale aqua and turquoise geometric fan-like patterns, outlined with a thin warm beige border, set against a clean light gray background. High-detail digital painting, glossy anime illustration, elegant action character art, crisp linework, rich fabric folds, dramatic perspective distortion, fashion-magazine polish, cool blue palette, white negative space, centered vertical composition.

items.promptZh: 现代浪漫喜剧风格的色彩干净的漫画页面，以 6 面板漫画布局呈现，白色页面上有清晰的黑色面板边框。场景发生在晴朗的户外，蓝天、软云、绿树成荫、铺好的人行道和带有铁链屏障的排队柱。主角是一位十几岁的动漫女孩，留着金色短发，被风吹散的发丝，金棕色的大眼睛，淡淡的腮红，表情严肃而略显尴尬。她戴着一顶带有奶油色毛皮和蓝色小圆点细节的松软狗耳帽，白色衬衫外面套着蓝色学校风格的羊毛衫或西装外套，打着红色图案的领带，手里拿着一个粉色漩涡状的软冰淇淋筒。一个身穿深蓝色毛衣和白领衬衫的十几岁男孩出现在 3 个画面中，他的脸被柔和的矩形模糊遮挡，还戴着一顶相配的松软狗耳帽。该页面应恰好有 6 个面板：顶行有 2 个小面板，横跨整个宽度的 1 个大型中央特写面板，以及底行有 3 个面板。左上面板：男孩面朝前方，女孩猛地转向他，她的头发和帽子因动作而飘扬，户外背景上有一块招牌，还有手绘的黑色漫画音效。右上面板：一个赤壁风格的小女孩站在铁链屏障附近，手里拿着冰淇淋，看上去得意又慌乱，还有一个对话气泡，上面写着“这是一种成就”。以及她头部附近浮动的小音效文字。中心面板：一幅戏剧性的特写肖像，画中的女孩在开阔的天空下，头发飘过她的脸，一根头发穿过她的嘴，狗耳朵清晰可见，凝视着前方，表情平静而震惊；右侧包括一个带有日语文本的垂直对话气泡和一个小的英文音效“PLOP”。左下图：男孩，脸部模糊，说话时有一个对话气泡，上面写着“我已经想这个有一段时间了，但是……”中下图：侧视图中的女孩将一只手伸向嘴边，另一只手拿着粉红色的冰淇淋，对话气泡上写着“谢谢”。右下图：男孩把手伸向女孩的嘴或脸颊，就像擦奶油一样，并带有一个对话气泡，上面写着“你这里有一些奶油”。将所有可见的漫画文本和声音效果融入艺术中，包括“WAH！”、“FWSH”和英语对话。在墨水线条艺术上使用抛光的漫画着色：柔和的卡通阴影、略带纹理的水彩般的填充、温暖的肤色、有光泽的眼睛、精细的交叉影线口音和富有表现力的线条。强调浪漫的张力、风的动作，以及喜剧赤壁反应和温柔的特写戏剧之间的对比。
items.prompt: A cleanly colored manga page in a modern romantic-comedy style, presented as a 6-panel comic layout with crisp black panel borders on a white page. The scene takes place outdoors on a bright day with blue sky, soft clouds, leafy green trees, paved walkway, and queue posts with chain barriers. The main subject is a teenage anime girl with a short blond bob haircut, loose windblown strands, large golden-brown eyes, light blush, and a serious slightly embarrassed expression. She wears a floppy dog-ear hat with cream fur and a small blue polka-dot cap detail, a blue school-style cardigan or blazer over a white shirt, and a red patterned necktie, while holding a pink swirled soft-serve ice cream cone. A teenage boy in a dark blue sweater and white collared shirt appears in 3 panels, his face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, also wearing a matching floppy dog-ear hat. The page should have exactly 6 panels: 2 small panels across the top row, 1 large central close-up panel spanning the width, and 3 panels along the bottom row. Top-left panel: the boy faces forward with the girl turning sharply toward him, her hair and hat flaring from motion, outdoor background with a signboard, and hand-drawn manga sound effects in black. Top-right panel: a small chibi-style version of the girl stands near the chain barrier, looking smug and flustered while holding the ice cream, with a speech bubble that says "THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT." and small floating sound-effect text near her head. Center panel: a dramatic close-up portrait of the girl against open sky, hair blowing across her face, one strand crossing her mouth, dog ears visible, staring forward with a calm, stunned look; include a vertical speech bubble on the right with Japanese text and a small English sound effect reading "PLOP". Bottom-left panel: the boy, face blurred, speaking with a speech bubble that says "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT..." Bottom-middle panel: the girl in side view lifting a hand toward her mouth while holding the pink ice cream in the other hand, with a speech bubble saying "THANKS." Bottom-right panel: the boy reaches toward the girl's mouth or cheek with his hand as if wiping off cream, with a speech bubble that says "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Keep all visible comic text and sound effects integrated into the art, including "WAH!", "FWSH", and the English dialogue. Use polished manga coloring over inked line art: soft cel shading, slightly textured watercolor-like fills, warm skin tones, glossy eyes, fine crosshatching accents, and expressive linework. Emphasize romantic tension, wind movement, and the contrast between comedic chibi reaction and tender close-up drama.

items.title: 海盗巨人激战漫画页
items.promptZh: 一个全彩色的少年漫画动作页面，采用高能海盗战斗漫画的风格，以单个漫画页面的形式呈现，有 4 个可见面板，由厚厚的白色排水沟和稍微倾斜的面板边框分隔开。使用大胆的黑色墨水线、密集的交叉阴影线、速度线、赛璐珞风格的着色、戏剧性的透视和夸张的冲击效果。场景中，一个肌肉发达、身材魁梧的巨型战士，皮肤呈棕褐色，戴着有角的头盔，黑色的头发和胡须，穿着毛皮装饰的黑色衣服，宽大的镶钉金属腰带和巨大的尖刺棍棒，正在与穿着深蓝色衣服和盔甲般头饰的剑客作战。上图：一个巨大的特写镜头，一只紧握的拳头以爆炸性的视角冲向观众，巨人高喊着“GUNGNIR！！！”在一个锯齿状的语音气球中，另一个气球上写着“GWOAH !!!”；添加大型红色日本音效和小型“DOOM!!”影响文本。中宽板：巨人向上摆动并咆哮“I​​KOKU SOVEREIGNTY！！！”而蓝衣对手则向左后退；包括一个语音气球，上面写着“GAH！”以及带有小“WHONK!!”的大型紫色日语音效。左下窄面板：裁剪后的特写设置面板，其中有两个堆叠的语音气球，上面写着“三剑风格”。和“红色食人魔……”，扬声器大部分不在画面内，部分被遮挡。右下大面板：巨人用一根巨大的木刺棒在框架上猛烈地水平粉碎，大喊“巨人特罗玛！！！”；包括较小的冲击气球，上面写着“DWUAH !!!”和“THWAM!!”，加上超大的红色日本音效。背景应该主要是淡天蓝色，带有沉重的运动线和飞行的碎片。保留专业彩色每周漫画页面的感觉：饱和的红色、蓝色、紫色、棕褐色肤色、奶油色毛皮纹理、黑色阴影以及带有手写漫画文本的清晰白色语音气球。
items.prompt: A fully colored shonen manga action page in the style of a high-energy pirate battle comic, presented as a single comic page with 4 visible panels separated by thick white gutters and slightly tilted panel borders. Use bold black ink lines, dense crosshatching, speed lines, cel-style coloring, dramatic foreshortening, and exaggerated impact effects. The scene shows a muscular, towering giant warrior with tan skin, a horned helmet, wild black hair and beard, fur-trimmed black clothing, a wide studded metal belt, and a massive spiked club, battling a swordsman in dark blue clothing and armor-like headgear. Top panel: an extreme close-up of a huge clenched fist thrusting toward the viewer with explosive perspective, the giant shouting “GUNGNIR !!!” in a jagged speech balloon, and another balloon reading “GWOAH !!!”; add large red Japanese sound effects and a small “DOOM!!” impact text. Middle wide panel: the giant swings upward and roars “IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY !!!” while the blue-clad opponent recoils at left; include a speech balloon saying “GAH!” and large purple Japanese sound effects with a small “WHONK!!”. Bottom left narrow panel: a cropped close-up setup panel with two stacked speech balloons reading “THREE SWORD STYLE.” and “RED OGRE…”, with the speaker mostly off-frame and partially obscured. Bottom right large panel: the giant drives a massive wooden spiked club across the frame in a violent horizontal smash, shouting “GIANT TROMMA !!!”; include smaller impact balloons reading “DWUAH !!!” and “THWAM!!”, plus oversized red Japanese sound effects. Backgrounds should be mostly pale sky blue with heavy motion lines and flying debris. Preserve the feel of a professionally colored weekly manga page: saturated reds, blues, purples, tan skin tones, cream fur textures, black shadows, and crisp white speech balloons with hand-lettered comic text.
items.author: Kokoboy

items.title: 足球场激战漫画彩页
items.promptZh: 戏剧性体育漫画风格的全彩漫画页，展示了挤满蓝白人群的巨大圆顶体育场内激烈的足球比赛。使用锐利的墨线、密集的交叉影线、网纹纹理、动态速度线和生动的动漫着色，就像黑白漫画页面经过专业着色一样。该构图是一个包含 3 个面板的单页：1 个大主面板覆盖了页面的大部分，加上 2 个沿左侧堆叠的窄对角插入面板。在主面板中，从升高的边线视角显示罚球区和球门的陡峭倾斜广角视图，绿草被透视拉伸并充满定向阴影。计算主面板中可见的 6 名球员：4 名蓝色制服球员和 2 名白色制服球员，以及球门处的 1 名黄色守门员。从后面可以看到最引人注目的球员位于中右下角，身穿印有“HUGO”和数字 9 的蓝色球衣，伸出一只手臂朝球场跑去。在他附近的右下边缘，展示了另一名身穿白色球衣、标有“ISAGI”、号码为 11 的球员，他也在向前奔跑。中景显示另外 4 名场上球员正在争夺球：3 名蓝色，1 名白色，其中一名身着白色制服的球员从右侧向中心水平冲刺。球门位于中左上方附近，黄色守门员支撑在网前。在主面板中添加 3 个对话气泡，大型白色漫画气球，上面有手写的大写英文文本：“但是我想赢得世界杯……”、“……作为第二佳球员和中场球员。”和“……最多次赢得世界杯的世界纪录……”。在左侧插入区域中，创建 2 个对角面板。上面的插图显示了一个蓝色黑发角色的特写镜头，部分被面部和躯干区域中央的柔和矩形模糊所遮挡，并有一个小对话气泡，上面写着“YOICHI ISAGI，你知道吗……”。下部插图显示了一个红发角色的特写镜头，他有一双蓝色的大眼睛，脸上有汗水，淡蓝色的背景，看起来很惊讶或震惊。保持大胆的黑色面板边框、戏剧性的透视效果和高能量的锦标赛氛围。使用具有强烈对比度和真实漫画页面着色美学的蓝色、绿色、白色和黄色调色板。
items.prompt: A full-color manga page in the style of a dramatic sports manga, showing an intense soccer match inside a huge domed stadium packed with a blue-and-white crowd. Use sharp ink lines, dense crosshatching, screentone texture, dynamic speed lines, and vivid anime coloring as if a black-and-white manga page has been professionally colorized. The composition is a single page with 3 panels: 1 large main panel covering most of the page, plus 2 narrow diagonal inset panels stacked along the left side. In the main panel, show a steeply tilted wide-angle view of the penalty area and goal from an elevated sideline perspective, with the green grass stretched by perspective and filled with directional hatching. Count 6 visible players in the main panel: 4 blue-uniform players and 2 white-uniform players, plus 1 goalkeeper in yellow at the goal. The most prominent player is seen from behind in the lower center-right wearing a blue jersey with “HUGO” and the number 9, running toward the play with one arm extended. Near him on the lower right edge, show another player in a white jersey labeled “ISAGI” with the number 11, also running forward. In the midground, show 4 more field players contesting the ball: 3 in blue and 1 in white, with one white-uniform player diving or lunging horizontally from the right toward the center. The goal stands near the top center-left, with the yellow goalkeeper bracing in front of the net. Add 3 speech bubbles in the main panel, large white manga balloons with hand-lettered uppercase English text: “BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...”, “...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.”, and “...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...”. In the left-side inset area, create 2 diagonal panels. The upper inset panel shows a close-up of a dark-haired character in blue, partly obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the center of the face and torso area, with a small speech bubble that says, “YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...”. The lower inset panel shows a close-up of a reddish-haired character with a wide blue eye, sweat on the face, and a pale blue background, looking surprised or stunned. Maintain bold black panel borders, dramatic foreshortening, and a high-energy tournament atmosphere. Use a blue, green, white, and yellow palette with strong contrast and authentic manga-page coloring aesthetics.

items.title: 粉彩无脸少女花束肖像
items.titleZh: 粉彩无脸少女花束肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅梦幻般的柔和动画肖像，描绘了一位精致的年轻女子从胸部以上的角度，以柔和空灵的构图为中心。她有一头很长、飘逸的波浪状{argument name="hair color" default="pale blush Pink"}头发，带有明亮的亮点，填充了大部分画面并融入背景。她的脸故意隐藏在一个大的居中实心矩形后面，呈柔和的尘土飞扬的腮红，创造出一种不露脸的个人资料图片占位符效果。她穿着一件淡蓝色、白色和粉色的褶边、浪漫的露肩连衣裙，饰有蕾丝边、荷叶边、缎面质地和超大丝带蝴蝶结；正好可以看到 3 个突出的蝴蝶结：1 个大蓝色蝴蝶结位于她右侧的头发上，1 个大粉红色蝴蝶结靠近她的左手腕，1 个粉红色蝴蝶结位于她的右肩袖上。她用双手轻轻地将一束小花捧在胸前；花束中包含浅蓝色、白色和粉色的柔和的小花朵，并用浅蓝色丝带系着。她的头发和衣服上装饰着散落的小花朵，背景充满了漂浮的花朵、花瓣、微小的心形和淡淡的丝带般的漩涡，营造出柔和的春天幻想气氛。使用极轻的高调调色板，水彩般的动漫渲染，飘逸的线条，光泽的头发光泽，蕾丝细节，柔和的阴影，干净的插图，垂直的智能手机壁纸构图，超可爱的少女美学，白色和腮红的背景，优雅天真的心情。
items.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime portrait of a delicate young woman shown from the chest up, centered in a soft ethereal composition. She has very long, flowing, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="pale blush pink"} hair with luminous highlights, filling most of the frame and blending into the background. Her face is intentionally hidden behind a large centered solid rectangle in muted dusty blush, creating a faceless profile-picture placeholder effect. She wears a frilly, romantic, off-shoulder dress in pale blue, white, and pink with lace trim, ruffles, satin texture, and oversized ribbon bows; exactly 3 prominent bows are visible: 1 large blue bow in her hair on the right side, 1 large pink bow near her left wrist, and 1 pink bow on her right shoulder sleeve. She gently holds a small bouquet close to her chest with both hands; the bouquet contains tiny pastel flowers in light blue, white, and pink, tied with a light blue ribbon. Her hair and outfit are decorated with scattered small blossoms, and the background is filled with floating flowers, petals, tiny hearts, and faint ribbon-like swirls for a soft spring fantasy atmosphere. Use a very light high-key palette, watercolor-like anime rendering, airy linework, glossy hair shine, lace detail, soft shading, clean illustration, vertical smartphone wallpaper composition, ultra-cute shoujo aesthetic, white and blush background, elegant and innocent mood.
items.author: 人中の便・星

items.title: 梦幻粉彩动漫少女肖像
items.titleZh: 梦幻粉彩动漫少女肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅梦幻般的柔和动漫肖像，描绘的是一位年轻女子，有着{argument name="hair color" default="pale blush Pink"}长长的飘逸卷发，从腰部到上方的干净白色背景上，散落着细小的花朵、花瓣和柔软的丝带状漩涡。她的脸完全被一个居中的垂直矩形所隐藏，呈柔和的尘土色腮红，创造出一种无脸的个人资料图片占位符效果。她的头发装饰着两个半透明的大丝带蝴蝶结，每侧一个，还有许多小花朵编织在头发上，就像一顶花冠。她穿着一件非常柔软的白色、淡紫色和粉色的露肩褶边连衣裙，配有泡泡袖、蕾丝边、花卉装饰和精致的蝴蝶结细节。她用双手轻轻地将一束小花捧在胸前；花束包含粉红色、奶油黄色、白色和浅蓝色的柔和花朵。构图居中、优雅、通风，具有超柔和的线条艺术、水彩风格的阴影、高细节、光线闪烁和浪漫的少女插画美学。使用苍白的调色板、飘逸的灯光、丝带的微妙透明度以及垂直海报般的构图。
items.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime portrait of a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="pale blush pink"} long flowing wavy hair, shown from the waist up against a clean white background with scattered tiny flowers, petals, and soft ribbon-like swirls. Her face is fully hidden by a centered vertical rectangle in a muted dusty blush color, creating a faceless profile-picture placeholder effect. Her hair is decorated with 2 large translucent ribbon bows, one on each side, and many small blossoms woven through the hair like a floral crown. She wears an off-shoulder frilly dress in very soft white, lavender, and pink with puff sleeves, lace trim, floral accents, and delicate bow details. She gently holds a small bouquet close to her chest with both hands; the bouquet contains pastel flowers in pink, cream yellow, white, and light blue. The composition is centered, elegant, and airy, with ultra-soft line art, watercolor-style shading, high detail, light sparkles, and a romantic shoujo illustration aesthetic. Use a pale color palette, ethereal lighting, subtle transparency in the ribbons, and a vertical poster-like composition.

items.title: 双色发几何动漫肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅干净的极简主义动漫肖像，描绘了一位年轻女子从胸部以上的位置，位于画面中央，她的脸被一个大的垂直软边灰色矩形完全遮挡，覆盖了整个面部区域作为审查块。她有一头飘逸的长发，分为两种色调，一侧是深海军蓝色，另一侧是浅银灰色，发丝向外扫动，仿佛被微风吹动。在头发上添加一些细细的珊瑚粉色条纹。她穿着高领、结构性的米白色外套或制服夹克，深藏青色内领镶片和两颗金色小纽扣，给人一种时尚现代的科幻时尚感。她的皮肤苍白，一只耳朵上戴着一个小耳钉。使用扁平、优雅的插画风格，带有平滑的矢量般的阴影，没有厚重的纹理，以及以粉蓝色、奶油色、海军蓝和珊瑚粉色为主的内敛柔和的调色板。背景应该是抽象的几何构图，而不是真实的背景：天蓝色背景上的大奶油色圆形和对角线形状，加上由细垂直线或曲线连接的恰好 5 个珊瑚圆形图形装饰，装饰性地排列在角色周围。保持构图通风、平衡和现代，采用柔和的线条、微妙的负空间和冷静的社论海报美学。
items.prompt: A clean minimalist anime portrait of a young woman from the chest up, centered in frame, with her face fully obscured by a large vertical soft-edged gray rectangle covering the entire facial area as a censorship block. She has very long flowing hair split into two tones, with deep navy blue on one side and pale silver-gray on the other, the strands sweeping outward as if moved by a gentle breeze. Add a few thin coral-pink accent streaks in the hair. She wears a high-collared, structured off-white coat or uniform jacket with a dark navy inner collar panel and two small gold buttons, giving a sleek modern sci-fi fashion feel. Her visible skin is pale, and one ear shows a tiny stud earring. Use a flat, elegant illustration style with smooth vector-like shading, no heavy texture, and a restrained pastel palette dominated by powder blue, cream, navy, and coral pink. The background should be an abstract geometric composition rather than a real setting: large cream circular and diagonal shapes over a sky-blue field, plus exactly 5 coral circular graphic accents connected by thin vertical or curved lines, arranged decoratively around the character. Keep the composition airy, balanced, and contemporary, with soft linework, subtle negative space, and a calm editorial poster aesthetic.

items.title: 和风花魁与猫鸟插画

items.titleZh: 四格漫画创作价值争论
items.prompt: Create a black-and-white manga page with 4 stacked horizontal panels, clean black gutters, screentone shading, dramatic speed lines, and polished seinen-style linework. The page features two youthful anime characters with modern casual clothing and short dark hair, with the face area of both characters obscured by a soft square blur censor block. Panel 1: a slim young person with messy short dark hair and a collared shirt clenches one fist near their chest, body angled left, surrounded by an intense fiery aura effect in the background, looking emotional and defensive. On the right side, place a large jagged vertical speech balloon containing this Japanese text: 「何十時間も魂を削って描いた一枚と、プロンプト打ち込んで数秒で出した画像が同じ価値なわけないでしょ！ふざけないで！」. Panel 2: a second young person with slightly taller build, short dark hair, a dark zip jacket over a light shirt, raises one index finger calmly as if explaining a point. Add a rounded rectangular speech box on the right with this Japanese text: 「投下した労働時間で価値が決まるという典型的な“労働価値説の誤謬”だ。市場における価値は、出力された結果を受け手がどう評価するかで決まる」. Panel 3: the taller character gently pats the shorter character on the head; include a small hand-pat sound effect near the hand reading 「ポン」. The shorter character looks up in surprise. On the right side, add a large oval vertical speech balloon with this Japanese text: 「でも俺の市場価値基準はすごくシンプルだよ。君が俺のために照れてくれるこの数秒間に、何十時間分の価値も感じてるから」. Panel 4: close-up of the shorter character blushing intensely with spiral eyes, sweat drops, trembling expression, open mouth, and dense hatching on the cheeks, overwhelmed with embarrassment. Fill the background with dramatic radiating speed lines. Add a large jagged vertical speech balloon on the right with this Japanese text: 「だ、誰がアンタのために照れるか…っ！自意識過剰よ！」. Add two sound effects: a small 「プル…」 near the shoulder and a larger shaky handwritten 「カァァァ」 along the lower left side. Keep the whole page monochrome, highly expressive, romantic-comedy manga tone, with strong emotional contrast between heated argument, cool explanation, teasing affection, and flustered payoff.

items.title: 猫咪吃醋四格漫画
items.promptZh: 可爱的手绘四格漫画，柔和、温暖、贴近生活的风格，浅奶油色背景，厚厚的黑色面板边框和略带纹理的纸纹。使用简单的圆形卡通猫解剖结构、富有表现力的面孔、干净的黑色轮廓、柔和的自然色彩以及温和的漫画式演示。在左上角的面板中，展示了两只猫：一只带有深色条纹和白色枪口的棕色虎斑猫，闭着眼睛坐着，看起来很高兴，而一只头上有深棕色斑块的白色猫站在它旁边，深情地舔着虎斑猫的脸颊；在其上方添加 2 个黑色小音符，以暗示快乐的修饰。在右上角的面板中，前景中的白色和棕色斑点的猫看着站在右侧的一只小印花布小猫；在小猫上方添加一个包含日语文本“めい”的对话气泡。在左下方的面板中，同时展示了 3 只猫：左边的棕色虎斑猫表情惊讶或茫然，右边的白色斑纹猫看起来很高兴，而小印花布小猫则位于它们中间，向上看。在右下角的面板中，展示了一只棕色虎斑猫的特写镜头，它面朝前方，黄绿色的眼睛眯成一条缝，表情愤怒、嫉妒；在脸部附近添加 2 条短强调线，并在右侧添加 1 个小泡芙形愤怒符号。保持语气舒适和喜剧，并用视觉笑话表示虎斑猫很高兴被梳理，直到新的小猫出现。使用单调的颜色、最小的阴影和迷人的日本网络漫画的感觉。
items.prompt: A cute hand-drawn four-panel comic in a soft, warm, slice-of-life style on a light cream background with thick black panel borders and slightly textured paper grain. Use simple rounded cartoon cat anatomy, expressive faces, clean black outlines, muted natural colors, and a gentle manga-like presentation. In the top-left panel, show 2 cats: a brown tabby cat with dark stripes and white muzzle sitting with eyes closed, looking pleased, while a mostly white cat with dark brown patches on the head stands beside it and affectionately licks the tabby's cheek; add 2 small black musical notes above them to suggest happy grooming. In the top-right panel, show the white-and-brown patched cat in the foreground looking toward a small calico kitten standing to the right; include a speech bubble containing the Japanese text "めい" above the kitten. In the bottom-left panel, show 3 cats together: the brown tabby on the left with a surprised or blank expression, the white patched cat on the right looking cheerful, and the small calico kitten centered in front between them, looking up. In the bottom-right panel, show a close-up of the brown tabby cat alone, facing forward with narrowed yellow-green eyes and an angry, jealous expression; add 2 short emphasis lines near the face and 1 small puff-shaped anger symbol to the right. Keep the tone cozy and comedic, with the visual joke that the tabby was happy being groomed until the new kitten appears. Use flat colors, minimal shading, and a charming Japanese webcomic feel.

items.title: 百八角色奇幻曼陀罗
items.promptZh:
一张巨大的、超详细的奇幻曼陀罗海报，上面有 108 个不同的赤壁角色，围绕着光芒四射的中央标志排列成同心圆环。构图整体上完美对称，充满了宽阔的水平画布，就像一幅华丽的收藏壁画。在中心放置一个发光的金色核心，上面有 9 个赤壁动物奇幻吉祥物，簇拥在一个圆形徽章中，每个吉祥物都有超大的头、微小的身体、富有表情的眼睛和奢华的服装细节。围绕该中心的是多个均匀分布的同心环，其中包含其余 99 个角色，每个角色占据自己的楔形部分，并设计为独特的元素或神话变体。包括狐类、兔类、猫类、狼类、狮子类、鸟类、龙类、鹿类、混合兽类角色，全部以可爱的超变形风格渲染，但拥有史诗般的高奇幻盔​​甲、长袍、王冠、羽毛、角、宝石、斗篷、法杖和魔法配件。通过颜色、轮廓、物种特征和元素主题使每个角色在视觉上截然不同，同时保留统一的绘画动漫奇幻美学。

使用丰富的调色板，以夜光金、象牙色、奶油色、紫罗兰色、靛蓝、蓝宝石和柔和的琥珀色为主，辅以深红色、冰青色、祖母绿和日落橙色。赋予图像神圣的天象图或黄道带轮的感觉，每个圆形带都由优雅的镀金边框和弧形分隔线分隔开。在许多角色周围添加发光的魔法能量、火花、光环、旋转的火焰、薄雾、雪、云、水花、闪电卷曲、花卉图案和天体粒子。在外周周围，将几个较大的装饰性守护者插图集成到边框中：左上方有一个明亮的太阳徽章，右上角的圆形面板中有一只白色的凤凰鸟，右下角有一个花卉或星爆徽章，左下方的圆形面板中有一个火热的字符簇，再加上沿着左右边缘嵌入的大型元素兽图形。整个艺术品采用精致的古董装饰边框，灵感来自于彩绘手稿和奇幻塔罗牌设计，使用金丝细工、角落奖章、几何装饰和神秘图案。

渲染应该非常密集和清晰，就像用于海报印刷的 4k 奇幻插图一样，整个图像上有微小的可读人物轮廓、复杂的线条、柔和的水彩纹理阴影、发光的亮点以及精美的收藏卡游戏概念艺术完成。强调丰富、和谐和放射状秩序：总共 108 个赤壁人物，排列成神话元素吉祥物的雄伟曼陀罗。
items.prompt:
A gigantic ultra-detailed fantasy mandala poster featuring exactly 108 distinct chibi characters arranged in concentric circular rings around a radiant central emblem. The composition is perfectly symmetrical overall and fills a wide horizontal canvas like an ornate collectible mural. In the center, place a glowing golden core with 9 chibi animal-fantasy mascots clustered in a circular medallion, each with oversized heads, tiny bodies, expressive eyes, and luxurious costume details. Surround this center with multiple evenly spaced concentric rings containing the remaining 99 characters, each character occupying its own wedge-like segment and designed as a unique elemental or mythical variation. Include fox-like, rabbit-like, cat-like, wolf-like, lion-like, bird-like, dragon-like, deer-like, and hybrid beast characters, all rendered in a cute super-deformed style but with epic high-fantasy armor, robes, crowns, feathers, horns, gems, capes, staffs, and magical accessories. Make every character visually distinct through color, silhouette, species traits, and elemental theme, while preserving a unified painterly anime-fantasy aesthetic.

Use a rich palette dominated by luminous gold, ivory, cream, violet, indigo, sapphire, and soft amber, with accents of crimson, icy cyan, emerald, and sunset orange. Give the image the feel of a sacred celestial chart or zodiac wheel, with each circular band separated by elegant gilded borders and arc dividers. Add glowing magical energy, sparkles, halos, swirling fire, mist, snow, clouds, water splashes, lightning curls, floral motifs, and celestial particles around many of the characters. Around the outer perimeter, place several larger decorative guardian illustrations integrated into the border: a bright sun medallion at the upper left, a white phoenix-like bird in a circular panel at the upper right, a floral or starburst medallion at the lower right, and a fiery character cluster in a circular panel at the lower left, plus additional large elemental beast figures embedded along the left and right edges. Frame the entire artwork with an elaborate antique ornamental border inspired by illuminated manuscripts and fantasy tarot designs, using filigree, corner medallions, geometric trim, and arcane motifs.

The rendering should be extremely dense and crisp, like a 4k fantasy illustration meant for a poster print, with tiny readable character silhouettes across the whole image, intricate linework, soft watercolor-textured shading, glowing highlights, and a polished collectible-card-game concept art finish. Emphasize abundance, harmony, and radial order: exactly 108 chibi figures total, arranged as a majestic mandala of mythical elemental mascots.

items.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style portrait of a seated shrine maiden princess in an opulent traditional Japanese palace interior, centered in a vertical composition. She is a young woman with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="mint green"} hair fading into yellow-green at the tips, soft pink accent strands, straight bangs, and ornate hair ornaments including 2 tall faceted crystal fox ears, 1 pink flower cluster, and 2 small ribbon clips. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft square blur. She wears an elaborate layered kimono and dress ensemble in deep indigo, violet, magenta, white, and gold, with rich brocade, floral embroidery, lace sleeves, tassels, cords, and jeweled obi ornaments. The outer robe is dark navy with intricate multicolor floral patterns and metallic trim; the inner dress is glossy white with ruffles and delicate translucent fabric. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.

items.prompt: A 2D anime illustration of a sleeping {argument name="character type" default="chibi witch"} with black hair, wearing a large black hat decorated with {argument name="hat decoration" default="metal gears"} and a dark outfit with belts. She rests on a soft, dark blue starry pillow shaped like a crescent moon, with "ZZZ" floating near her head. She is accompanied by {argument name="animal companions" default="two black birds, one wearing a tiny top hat"}. The scene is framed by a circular night sky background featuring a glowing crescent moon and stars. The bottom edge is adorned with fluffy clouds and {argument name="props" default="steampunk gears, a glowing lantern, and a closed spellbook"}. The artwork features a {argument name="color palette" default="dark blue, black, and warm gold"} color palette and is styled as a paper cutout or die-cut sticker with a soft drop shadow against a plain off-white background.

items.title: 海贼王角色写实动漫便利店夜景
items.prompt:
请生成8张独立9:16图片（不要拼接成一张）：
比例：9:16
风格：真人手机随拍写实（photorealistic candid phone photo）。朋友用手机后置主摄26mm随手抓拍，手持轻微倾斜，画面有轻微手机噪点和局部过曝，未经精修，非影棚非商业大片非电影调色。
主题：海贼王女角色深夜便利店——像被朋友偷拍到的真实生活瞬间，一人一图，共八人。
人物形象须与其在原作动漫中的形象高度一致，关键发型/发色/五官气质/标志特征清晰可辨，避免换成认不出的路人脸。
女性角色颜值：韩系女神感，精致小巧鹅蛋脸，眼睛大而清透有湿润感，虹膜有环境光反射，唇纹自然，左右脸极轻微自然不对称。
皮肤：中度真实——细小毛孔（脸颊鼻翼）、面部绒毛、一两颗浅痣、T区轻微皮脂高光、局部肤色冷暖变化；禁止塑料/陶瓷/蜡像/过度磨皮/全脸统一砂纸感。
身材：纤细苗条，大长腿，比例修长，腰肢纤细；全身站立时腿部线条修长优美。
服装：以原作标志性服饰为基底（保留轮廓、主色与标志配件，一眼可认出），在便利店语境下自然穿着（可略清凉但生活化）；非色情非擦边；适合公开平台。
叙事钩子（每张必须）：她正在挑零食/吃糖/看手机/拿饮料时，被朋友从侧后方叫了一声，反应为——回头、嘴里还有东西、或动作停在半空、或先愣一下再忍不住笑。不是摆拍，是被抓到的瞬间。
环境clutter（每张必须包含5+生活杂物）：便利店货架、冰柜冷白光、零食包装袋、收银台、饮料瓶、价签、塑料袋、地面反光、门口地垫、关东煮蒸汽。
光线：便利店冷白日光灯为主+冰柜侧光+门外路灯暖光渗入；不要电影级布光，不要均匀柔光，允许冷暖不均和局部过曝。
相机：朋友手持手机后置26mm，略低于视线高度，画面轻微倾斜1-3度，有轻微广角透视（腿部略拉伸），噪点可见，非三脚架非稳定器。
人物（全部来自 ONE PIECE，每张一个，共8人，明确成年，东亚审美）：
1) 娜美（橙发、导航员经典装与左肩纹身，嘴里叼着棒棒糖回头）

items.title: 少女动漫插画梦幻花园忧郁
items.prompt: 一幅梦幻般的粉彩动漫插画，描绘了一位宁静的少女在月光下的春日花园池畔。画面采用精致的日式奇幻风格，平涂动漫色彩，无阴影，线条极其干净，无颗粒感。她以四分之三背影坐在水边，脸庞微微转向观众，表情平静而忧郁。她留着极长的直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，配有柔和的刘海，发间编织着花朵装饰，形成花冠。她身穿优雅飘逸的淡蓝色与奶油色和服，上面饰有风格化的波浪和白狐图案，层叠的布料在周围铺开。右后方斜靠着一把半开的传统纸伞，伞上悬挂着水晶般的装饰物。头顶上方环绕着茂密的樱花枝，前景中散落着花瓣。池塘中漂浮着 10 朵发光的莲花，水面附近有 4 条清晰可见的锦鲤在游动。远处的左侧背景中，水面上隐约可见一座小型多层宝塔的剪影。从左上方，一道柔和的彩虹光束斜射入池塘，营造出虹彩般的倒影。树枝上悬挂着几串刻面水晶装饰，在光线下闪烁。色调以薰衣草紫、淡粉色、淡蓝色、象牙白和柔和的金色为主。整体氛围空灵、浪漫、宁静且充满魔力，细节装饰繁复，水面反光熠熠生辉，构图精致且呈竖向布局。

items.title: 女性动漫插画室内温暖优雅
items.prompt: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫风格时尚插画，描绘一位年轻女性站在明亮的现代购物中心或交通中庭的室内自动扶梯上。她戴着一顶 {argument name="hat style" default="带有光泽饰带的黑色报童帽"}，齐肩浅棕色头发从帽檐下露出，佩戴着长款吊坠耳环，身穿一件干练的 {argument name="blouse color" default="白色"} 短袖衬衫，衬衫带有泡泡袖，领口处系着一个大蝴蝶结，搭配一条高腰 {argument name="skirt color" default="黑色"} 百褶中长裙，并背着一个带有金链条的小型黑色绗缝单肩包。她的面部特意采用了柔和的方形隐私模糊处理，而图像其余部分保持清晰。以略低于视角的角度展现她的全身，一只手自然垂在身侧，另一只手轻轻搭在扶梯扶手上，姿态优雅从容。背景是一个宽敞的玻璃屋顶室内空间，配有斜向钢梁、大理石或深色石材墙板、温暖的木质天花板装饰、玻璃栏杆，以及她身后延伸的一对平行自动扶梯；画面中包含上层人物隐约的远景剪影。采用写实动漫渲染风格，线条清晰，皮肤阴影柔和，织物褶皱细节丰富，自动扶梯金属扶手具有光泽反射，明亮的初夏日光透过天窗倾泻而下，光线明快通透，具有浅景深效果，营造出时尚的都市出行氛围，竖构图，高细节。

items.title: 女性动漫插画梦幻城市
items.prompt: 一张梦幻般的动漫片尾插画，描绘了一位年轻女性侧坐在充满奇幻色彩的玫瑰与书籍图书馆中，周围环绕着飘落的花瓣和翻开的书籍。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳紫色"} 的高马尾，用黑色发圈束起，留有随意的刘海，戴着小巧的金耳环，刘海旁别着一个写有“AI”字样的微型金色发夹。她的面部大部分被柔和的矩形模糊处理，但构图上她依然是核心主角。她身穿一件印有醒目白色文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} 的青绿色 T 恤，外搭一件冰蓝色超大款粉色泼墨风衣，下身穿着浅色牛仔短裤。她右手拿着 1 朵红玫瑰，左手拿着一本深蓝色精装书，书名显示为 {argument name="book title" default="Roses & Books"}。让她以一种时尚动漫片尾主视觉图的姿态随意地斜倚着，一条腿伸直，另一条腿弯曲。场景是一个华丽的奇幻阅读角，左右两侧各堆叠着 2 摞高耸的书籍，并缠绕着盛开的红粉色玫瑰藤蔓。画面中需包含 6 个清晰可见、带有装饰性衬线字体的书脊或封面，标题分别为：“Poems & Books”、“Roses & Books”、“Dreams”、“Memories”、“Letters” 和 “Language of Flowers”。在左下角放置 1 个外带咖啡杯，杯上印有 {argument name="cup text" default="Read. Write. Bloom."} 字样。在前景的双腿附近放置 1 本打开的笔记本和一支笔，展示着玫瑰素描和笔记，右下角另有 1 本打开的植物学插画书。在上方区域，加入 4 本悬浮的打开书籍和几页在空中飘散的纸张。在她身后，设计一扇明亮的拱形窗户，透出窗外粉彩色的童话城市，背景是带有大教堂式尖顶的晴朗天蓝色天空。整幅画面充满散落的红粉色玫瑰花瓣、闪光点、柔和的绘画光影、装饰性花卉细节，以及海军蓝、粉色和奶油色等色彩丰富的书封。采用精致的动漫插画风格，线条细腻，高光呈现出明亮的粉彩质感，营造出浪漫的奇幻氛围，构图平衡对称，呈现出适合 {argument name="occasion" default="圣乔治节"} 的春日书籍与玫瑰主题纪念视觉效果。

items.title: 少女动漫插画霓虹夜景可爱
items.prompt: 一位美丽可爱的动漫少女手持巨大的 {argument name="weapon" default="巨剑"}，双重曝光插画，少女站在 {argument name="location" default="霓虹闪烁的夜之城"}，超现实的 {argument name="sky" default="宇宙星空夜景"}，在少女巨剑的剪影内呈现出紫色发光的星座，双重曝光效果仅限于少女的巨剑剪影内，巨剑剪影内部仅包含宁静而神秘的深紫色与宇宙紫。

items.title: 角色电影感写实城市梦幻可爱
items.prompt:
超电影感黄金时刻城市日落街景，中心消失点构图，耀眼的橙色太阳完美对齐在摩天大楼之间，梦幻怀旧氛围，繁忙的城市大道，柔和的交通灯与反射光线的湿润路面，{argument name="subjects" default="四位朋友"} 背对镜头向日落走去，温馨的情感氛围，一对情侣边走边拥抱，{argument name="lighting style" default="温暖的轮廓光"} 环绕角色，写实动漫风格插画与电影摄影相结合，柔和光晕，体积光，闪烁的散景光点，发光的窗户，淡淡的薄雾，{argument name="doodles" default="手绘日文涂鸦和箭头"} 漂浮在场景周围，可爱的白色草图注释，小爱心和闪光，审美感社交媒体 moodboard 风格，情感叙事，建筑细节丰富，电影感景深，沥青路面上的日落倒影，魔幻城市氛围，柔和的橙色和粉色天空渐变，优雅构图，高度细节，杰作，超写实光影，柔和阴影，梦幻光泽，8k，病毒式传播的审美艺术作品
